WITH sat_excellence AS (
  SELECT
    school_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN score >= 1500 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS sat_excellence_rate
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY school_id
)
SELECT
  MAX(s.ages_5_17_free_meal_eligibility_rate) AS max_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN sat_excellence se ON s.school_id = se.school_id
WHERE se.sat_excellence_rate > 0.3

SELECT 
  s."School", 
  s."District", 
  s."County",
  s."Grade Span", 
  f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f 
  ON s."School" = f."School" 
  AND s."District" = f."District" 
  AND s."County" = f."County"
WHERE 
  s."County" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s."Grade Span" = 'K-9'

SELECT 
    schools.district_code,
    (CAST(schools.k12_free_meal_recipients AS FLOAT) / schools.k12_enrollment) * 100 AS percent_eligible_free_k12
FROM 
    schools
JOIN 
    administrators ON schools.admin_id = administrators.admin_id
WHERE 
    administrators.first_name = 'Alusine'
      AND schools.k12_enrollment > 0

SELECT ncessch, enrollment_5_17
FROM schools
WHERE cds IN ('1751010130583', '1612910137588', '1611760134270')
AND enrollment_5_17 = (
    SELECT MAX(enrollment_5_17)
    FROM schools
    WHERE cds IN ('1751010130583', '1612910137588', '1611760134270')
)

WITH schools_in_network AS (
  SELECT school_id
  FROM schools
  WHERE charter_number = 756 AND mailing_city = 'San Diego'
),
test_takers_per_school AS (
  SELECT s.school_id, COALESCE(SUM(sa.num_test_takers), 0) AS total_test_takers
  FROM schools_in_network s
  LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON s.school_id = sa.school_id
  GROUP BY s.school_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_test_takers * 1.0), 2) AS avg_test_takers_per_school
FROM test_takers_per_school;

WITH hs_in_district AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.name,
    s.low_grade_served,
    s.high_grade_served
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.district_nces_id = '0613360'
    AND s.is_operating = 1
    AND s.high_grade_served = 12
    AND s.enrollment_grade_12 > 0
),
satless_hs AS (
  SELECT
    h.school_id,
    h.name,
    h.low_grade_served,
    h.high_grade_served
  FROM hs_in_district h
  LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON h.school_id = sa.school_id
  WHERE COALESCE(sa.num_test_takers, 0) = 0
)
SELECT
  sh.name,
  sh.low_grade_served,
  sh.high_grade_served
FROM satless_hs sh
WHERE sh.low_grade_served = (
    SELECT MIN(low_grade_served) FROM satless_hs
)
ORDER BY sh.name ASC;

WITH state_board_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.name AS school_name,
    s.mailing_street
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.district_type = 'State Board of Education'
    AND (s.agency_type = 'School' OR s.admin_agency = 'State Board of Education')
),
school_sat AS (
  SELECT
    sat.school_id,
    AVG(sat.reading_score) AS avg_reading_score
  FROM satscores sat
  WHERE sat.sat_level = 'school'
  GROUP BY sat.school_id
),
max_score AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(ss.avg_reading_score) AS max_reading
  FROM school_sat ss
  JOIN state_board_schools sbs ON ss.school_id = sbs.school_id
)
SELECT
  sbs.school_name,
  sbs.mailing_street,
  ss.avg_reading_score
FROM state_board_schools sbs
JOIN school_sat ss ON sbs.school_id = ss.school_id
JOIN max_score ms ON ss.avg_reading_score = ms.max_reading
ORDER BY sbs.school_name;

SELECT city
FROM schools
WHERE cds = '1611920113902'
  AND county = 'Alameda'
  AND breakfast_program = 'Provision 2'
  AND educational_instruction_level_code = 'HS'
  AND lowest_grade <= 9
  AND highest_grade >= 12
LIMIT 1;

WITH sbc_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.school_name,
    s.phone
  FROM
    schools s
  WHERE
    s.charter_authorizer = 'State Board of Education'
    AND s.charter_network_type = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
    AND s.state = 'CA'
),
high_score_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sc.school_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_high_scorers
  FROM
    satscores sc
  WHERE
    sc.total_score >= 1500
  GROUP BY
    sc.school_id
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    sbc_schools.school_name,
    sbc_schools.phone,
    COALESCE(hsc.num_high_scorers, 0) AS num_high_scorers
  FROM
    sbc_schools
    LEFT JOIN high_score_counts hsc ON sbc_schools.school_id = hsc.school_id
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  phone
FROM
  joined
WHERE
  num_high_scorers = (
    SELECT MAX(num_high_scorers) FROM joined
  )
  AND num_high_scorers > 0
;

SELECT 
    s.school_name,
    sa.avg_math AS average_sat_math_score,
    sa.num_tested AS sat_test_takers
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores sa ON s.school_id = sa.school_id
WHERE 
    s.cds_code = '1611190130609'
    AND s.charter_funding = 'Direct'
    AND s.school_level = 'High'
LIMIT 1;

WITH reference_school AS (
  SELECT sat_participants
  FROM satscores
  WHERE cds = '7618040730051'
),
contra_costa_schools AS (
  SELECT s.school_id, sa.sat_participants
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sa ON s.school_id = sa.school_id
  WHERE s.county_name = 'CONTRA COSTA'
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM contra_costa_schools, reference_school
WHERE contra_costa_schools.sat_participants > reference_school.sat_participants

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cdscode
WHERE s.mailingcity = 'San Francisco'
  AND s.type = 'Public'
  AND s.districttype IN (
    'Unified School District', 
    'High School District', 
    'Elementary School District', 
    'County Office of Education (COE)'
  )
  AND (sat.avg_reading + sat.avg_math + sat.avg_writing) >= 1500;

SELECT MIN(low_grade) AS lowest_grade_served
FROM schools
WHERE nces_district_id = '0632640'

WITH youth_authority_schools AS (
  SELECT school_id
  FROM schools
  WHERE agency_type = 'Youth Authority Facility'
),
meal_eligible_students AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(frp_eligible), 0) AS total_eligible
  FROM youth_authority_schools s
  LEFT JOIN frpm f
    ON s.school_id = f.school_id
    AND f.academic_year = '2014-2015'
    AND f.age_low = 5
    AND f.age_high = 17
  GROUP BY s.school_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_eligible * 1.0), 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_per_school
FROM meal_eligible_students;

SELECT name, education_level 
FROM schools 
WHERE cds_code = '1612590136051'
LIMIT 1;

WITH state_board_schools AS (
  SELECT school_id, school_name, administrator_email
  FROM schools
  WHERE district_ownership_type = 'State Board of Education'
),
sat_1500_counts AS (
  SELECT s.school_id, COUNT(*) AS num_1500
  FROM satscores AS s
  INNER JOIN state_board_schools AS sb
    ON s.school_id = sb.school_id
  WHERE s.total_score >= 1500
  GROUP BY s.school_id
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(num_1500) AS max_1500
  FROM sat_1500_counts
)
SELECT sb.school_name, sb.administrator_email
FROM state_board_schools AS sb
INNER JOIN sat_1500_counts sc ON sb.school_id = sc.school_id
INNER JOIN max_count mc ON sc.num_1500 = mc.max_1500
;

WITH candidate_middle_schools AS (
  SELECT
    School,
    "School Type",
    Latitude
  FROM schools
  WHERE
    -- Include any school whose type suggests middle grades
    LOWER("School Type") LIKE '%middle%'
    OR LOWER("School Type") LIKE '%junior high%'
    OR LOWER("School Type") LIKE '%intermediate%'
    -- Or whose school name contains 'middle' (including junior highs with 'Middle' in their name)
    OR LOWER(School) LIKE '%middle%'
),
max_latitude AS (
  SELECT MAX(Latitude) AS max_lat FROM candidate_middle_schools
)
SELECT
  School,
  "School Type",
  Latitude
FROM candidate_middle_schools, max_latitude
WHERE Latitude = max_lat;

WITH la_2007_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    s.school_id,
    s.nces_school_id,
    s.school_name
  FROM schools s
  WHERE 
    s.county_name = 'Los Angeles' 
    AND s.open_date BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2007-12-31'
    AND (s.district_type = 'School District' OR s.district_type = 'County Office of Education')
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(ss.num_sat_test_takers, 0)), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers_per_school
FROM la_2007_schools l
LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON 
  l.school_id = ss.school_id

WITH active_charter_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.funding_category,
    s.status,
    s.is_charter,
    s.k12_2014_enrollment,
    s.k12_2014_frpm_eligible_percent
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.is_charter = 1
    AND s.status = 'Active'
    AND s.funding_category IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
sat_results AS (
  SELECT
    sc.school_id,
    (ss.avg_reading_score + ss.avg_math_score + ss.avg_writing_score) AS combined_sat
  FROM satscores ss
  JOIN schools sc ON ss.school_id = sc.school_id
)
SELECT
  acs.funding_category,
  COUNT(acs.school_id) AS num_active_charter_schools,
  SUM(acs.k12_2014_enrollment) AS total_2014_15_k12_enrollment,
  ROUND(AVG(acs.k12_2014_frpm_eligible_percent), 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_percent,
  ROUND(AVG(sr.combined_sat), 2) AS avg_combined_sat_score
FROM active_charter_schools acs
LEFT JOIN sat_results sr ON acs.school_id = sr.school_id
GROUP BY acs.funding_category
ORDER BY acs.funding_category;

WITH state_special_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_code,
    s.name,
    s.k12enroll_1415,
    s.gslo_1415,
    s.gslo_1415 AS grade_start_code
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.statetype = 'StateSpecial'
),
grade_ordering AS (
  SELECT 'P' AS code, 0 AS order_num UNION ALL
  SELECT 'K', 1 UNION ALL
  SELECT '1', 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT '2', 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT '3', 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT '4', 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT '5', 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT '6', 7 UNION ALL
  SELECT '7', 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT '8', 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT '9', 10 UNION ALL
  SELECT '10', 11 UNION ALL
  SELECT '11', 12 UNION ALL
  SELECT '12', 13
),
sats_with_zero AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_code,
    s.name,
    s.k12enroll_1415,
    s.gslo_1415,
    COALESCE(SUM(ss.numtsttakr), 0) AS sat_test_takers,
    g.order_num
  FROM state_special_schools s
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss
    ON s.school_code = ss.school_code AND ss.year = '2014-15'
  LEFT JOIN grade_ordering g
    ON s.gslo_1415 = g.code
  GROUP BY s.school_code, s.name, s.k12enroll_1415, s.gslo_1415, g.order_num
)
SELECT
  name,
  gslo_1415 AS earliest_grade_level,
  k12enroll_1415,
  sat_test_takers
FROM sats_with_zero
WHERE order_num = (
  SELECT MAX(order_num) FROM sats_with_zero
)
ORDER BY k12enroll_1415 DESC, name ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH county_charter_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.cdscode,
    s.school_name,
    s.status,
    s.charter,
    s.charter_funding_type,
    s.authorizer_code,
    sa.authorizer_type,
    s.enrollment,
    s.frpm_eligible
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN schools sa
    ON s.authorizer_code = sa.cdscode
  WHERE
    s.status = 'Active' -- currently operating
    AND s.charter = 'Yes'
    AND sa.authorizer_type = 'County Office of Education'
    AND s.charter_funding_type IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
)
SELECT
  charter_funding_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) AS num_currently_operating_charter_schools,
  SUM(enrollment) AS total_k12_enrollment,
  SUM(frpm_eligible) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM county_charter_schools
GROUP BY charter_funding_type
ORDER BY
  CASE charter_funding_type
    WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END
;

WITH closed_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.name AS school_name,
    s.district,
    s.county,
    sc.sat_writing_avg
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sc ON s.id = sc.school_id
  WHERE s.status = 'Closed'
    AND sc.sat_writing_avg IS NOT NULL
),
score_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat_writing_avg DESC) AS score_rank
  FROM closed_schools
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  district,
  county,
  sat_writing_avg
FROM score_ranks
WHERE sat_writing_avg = (
    SELECT MAX(sat_writing_avg)
    FROM closed_schools
    WHERE sat_writing_avg < (SELECT MAX(sat_writing_avg) FROM closed_schools)
)
ORDER BY school_name;

WITH open_high_schools AS (
  SELECT cds, ncessch, school_name
  FROM schools
  WHERE state = 'CA'
    AND status = 'Active'
    AND instr_level = 'High School'
    AND type = 'Public'
),
sat_participation AS (
  SELECT s.cds, s.ncessch
  FROM open_high_schools s
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat
    ON (s.cds = sat.cds OR s.ncessch = sat.ncessch)
  GROUP BY s.cds, s.ncessch
  HAVING SUM(COALESCE(sat.num_test_takers, 0)) = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools_with_zero_sat_takers
FROM sat_participation;

WITH target_county AS (
    SELECT county_name
    FROM frpm
    WHERE cds_code = '1612590125716'
    LIMIT 1
),
filtered_schools AS (
    SELECT
        f.cds_code,
        f.county_name,
        f.school_name,
        f.enroll_k_12,
        f.free_meal_k_12,
        f.frpm_k_12,
        f.charter_indicator,
        -- Calculate percentages rounded to 2 decimals per the instruction
        ROUND(
            CASE 
                WHEN IFNULL(f.enroll_k_12,0) > 0 THEN 
                    CAST(f.free_meal_k_12 AS FLOAT) / f.enroll_k_12 * 100
                ELSE NULL
            END, 2
        ) AS free_meal_pct,
        ROUND(
            CASE 
                WHEN IFNULL(f.enroll_k_12,0) > 0 THEN 
                    CAST(f.frpm_k_12 AS FLOAT) / f.enroll_k_12 * 100
                ELSE NULL
            END, 2
        ) AS frpm_pct
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN target_county tc ON f.county_name = tc.county_name
    WHERE f.enroll_k_12 IS NOT NULL
      AND f.free_meal_k_12 > 500
      AND f.frpm_k_12 < 700
),
sat_per_school AS (
    SELECT
        s.cds_code,
        -- Only include schools with SAT results for all three sections (read, math, write)
        (s.sat_critical_read_avg + s.sat_math_avg + s.sat_write_avg) AS total_sat_score
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.sat_critical_read_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND s.sat_math_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND s.sat_write_avg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    fs.county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(fs.free_meal_pct),2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(fs.frpm_pct),2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fs.charter_indicator = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fs.charter_indicator = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_noncharter,
    ROUND(AVG(sp.total_sat_score),2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM filtered_schools fs
LEFT JOIN sat_per_school sp ON fs.cds_code = sp.cds_code
GROUP BY fs.county_name
;

WITH san_diego_schools_1980 AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%m', open_date) AS month
  FROM schools
  WHERE
    county_name = 'San Diego'
    AND agency_type IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District')
    AND open_date BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'
)
SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / 12 AS avg_schools_opened_per_month_1980
FROM san_diego_schools_1980;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.virtual == 'F' OR s.virtual == 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
    / COUNT(*), 
    1
  ) AS percent_virtual
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.school_id = sat.school_id
WHERE s.state = 'CA'
  AND sat.sat_math_avg > 400

WITH school_info AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    name,
    county,
    district,
    city,
    enr_k12
  FROM schools
  WHERE cds = '1612590137943'
),
frpm_info AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    frpm_k12,
    frpm_percent_k12
  FROM frpm
  WHERE cds = '1612590137943'
),
sat_info AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    num_tst_takers,
    avg_reading,
    avg_math,
    avg_writing,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN tot_score >= 1500 THEN 1 END) AS num_1500_or_above
  FROM satscores
  WHERE cds = '1612590137943'
  GROUP BY cds, num_tst_takers, avg_reading, avg_math, avg_writing
)
SELECT
  s.name,
  s.county,
  s.district,
  s.city,
  s.enr_k12 AS k12_enrollment,
  f.frpm_k12 AS k12_frpm_eligible,
  f.frpm_percent_k12 AS k12_frpm_percent_eligible,
  t.num_tst_takers AS sat_num_test_takers,
  t.avg_reading AS sat_avg_reading,
  t.avg_math AS sat_avg_math,
  t.avg_writing AS sat_avg_writing,
  t.num_1500_or_above AS sat_num_1500plus
FROM school_info s
LEFT JOIN frpm_info f ON s.cds = f.cds
LEFT JOIN sat_info t ON s.cds = t.cds;

WITH alameda_12th_grade_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.SchoolCode,
    s.SchoolName,
    s.CharterYN,
    s.GSserved,
    frpm.K12FreeMealCount,
    frpm.K12Enrollment
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN frpm ON s.SchoolCode = frpm.SchoolCode
  WHERE s.CountyName = 'Alameda'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12'
    AND frpm.K12Enrollment > 0
),
meal_rates AS (
  SELECT
    SchoolCode,
    SchoolName,
    CharterYN,
    GSserved,
    K12FreeMealCount,
    K12Enrollment,
    CAST(K12FreeMealCount AS FLOAT) / K12Enrollment AS free_meal_rate
  FROM alameda_12th_grade_schools
),
max_rate AS (
  SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS max_free_meal_rate
  FROM meal_rates
),
tagged_schools AS (
  SELECT
    m.SchoolCode,
    m.SchoolName,
    CASE
      WHEN m.CharterYN = 'Y' THEN 'Yes'
      WHEN m.CharterYN = 'N' THEN 'No'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS CharterSchool,
    m.GSserved,
    ROUND(m.free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
    s.TotalSAT as total_sat
  FROM meal_rates m
  JOIN max_rate r ON m.free_meal_rate = r.max_free_meal_rate
  LEFT JOIN satscores s ON m.SchoolCode = s.SchoolCode
),
final_output AS (
  SELECT
    SchoolName,
    printf("%.4f", free_meal_rate) AS FreeMealRate,
    CharterSchool,
    GSserved AS GradesServed,
    CASE
      WHEN total_sat IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
      WHEN total_sat < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN total_sat <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
      WHEN total_sat > 1500 THEN 'Above Average'
      ELSE 'No SAT Data'
    END AS SATPerformanceLevel
  FROM tagged_schools
)
SELECT * FROM final_output;

WITH target_school AS (
  SELECT 
    s.cds AS school_cds,
    s.name AS school_name,
    s.phone,
    s.website,
    s.charter,
    s.k12enroll_2014_15,
    s.frpm_percent_2014_15,
    sat.sat_read,
    sat.sat_math,
    sat.sat_write
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat
    ON s.cds = sat.cds
  WHERE s.cds = '7618040113118'
),
max_math_score AS (
  SELECT MAX(sat_math) AS highest_math
  FROM satscores ss
  INNER JOIN schools s ON ss.cds = s.cds
  WHERE ss.test_takers >= 10 AND s.active = 1
)
SELECT 
  t.school_name,
  t.phone,
  t.website,
  t.sat_read AS avg_sat_reading,
  t.sat_math AS avg_sat_math,
  t.sat_write AS avg_sat_writing,
  CASE WHEN t.charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_charter_school,
  t.k12enroll_2014_15,
  ROUND(t.frpm_percent_2014_15 * 100, 2) AS frpm_percent_2014_15,
  m.highest_math AS highest_avg_sat_math,
  (m.highest_math - t.sat_math) AS school_below_highest_math
FROM target_school t
CROSS JOIN max_math_score m
;

WITH exclusively_virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.SchoolID,
        s.Name AS SchoolName,
        s.County,
        s.Virtual
    FROM
        schools s
    WHERE
        s.Virtual = 'F'
),
county_virtual_counts AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        COUNT(*) AS ExclusivelyVirtualCount
    FROM exclusively_virtual_schools
    GROUP BY County
),
top_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ExclusivelyVirtualCount
    FROM county_virtual_counts
    GROUP BY ExclusivelyVirtualCount
    ORDER BY ExclusivelyVirtualCount DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
fifth_highest_count AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(ExclusivelyVirtualCount) AS FifthHighest
    FROM top_counts
),
top_counties AS (
    SELECT
        cvc.County,
        cvc.ExclusivelyVirtualCount
    FROM county_virtual_counts cvc
    JOIN fifth_highest_count fhc
        ON cvc.ExclusivelyVirtualCount >= fhc.FifthHighest
),
virtual_sat_scores AS (
    SELECT
        evs.SchoolID,
        evs.SchoolName,
        evs.County,
        sat.ReadingAvgScore
    FROM exclusively_virtual_schools evs
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat
        ON evs.SchoolID = sat.SchoolID
),
max_reading_per_county AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        MAX(ReadingAvgScore) AS MaxReading
    FROM virtual_sat_scores
    GROUP BY County
),
best_schools_per_county AS (
    SELECT
        vss.County,
        vss.SchoolName,
        vss.ReadingAvgScore
    FROM virtual_sat_scores vss
    JOIN max_reading_per_county mrc
        ON vss.County = mrc.County
        AND (
            (vss.ReadingAvgScore = mrc.MaxReading AND vss.ReadingAvgScore IS NOT NULL)
            OR (mrc.MaxReading IS NULL AND vss.ReadingAvgScore IS NULL)
        )
),
counties_with_no_sat AS (
    SELECT
        evs.County
    FROM exclusively_virtual_schools evs
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON evs.SchoolID = sat.SchoolID
    GROUP BY evs.County
    HAVING MAX(sat.ReadingAvgScore) IS NULL
),
schools_to_report AS (
    -- Counties with SAT scores
    SELECT
        tc.County,
        tc.ExclusivelyVirtualCount,

WITH eligible_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.cds_code,
    s.school_name,
    s.county,
    s.city,
    s.mailing_street,
    s.mailing_city,
    s.mailing_state,
    s.mailing_zip,
    s.website,
    s.k12_enrollment,
    f.frpm_eligible,
    CAST(f.frpm_eligible AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(s.k12_enrollment, 0) AS frpm_share,
    s.open_date,
    s.closed_date,
    CASE WHEN s.closed_date IS NULL THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END AS status
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.cds_code = f.cds_code
  WHERE
    s.school_type = 'Regular'
    AND (s.charter_flag IS NULL OR s.charter_flag = 'N')
    AND s.k12_enrollment > 100
),
sat AS (
  SELECT
    ss.cds_code,
    AVG(ss.reading_score + ss.math_score + ss.writing_score) AS avg_sat_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (ss.reading_score + ss.math_score + ss.writing_score) >= 1500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_1500_plus
  FROM satscores ss
  GROUP BY ss.cds_code
),
extremes AS (
  -- Largest FRPM-eligible count
  SELECT
    'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS label,
    es.*
  FROM eligible_schools es
  JOIN (
    SELECT frpm_eligible, k12_enrollment
    FROM eligible_schools
    WHERE frpm_eligible IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY frpm_eligible DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) maxfrpm ON es.frpm_eligible = maxfrpm.frpm_eligible
  -- Smallest FRPM share
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'smallest FRPM share' AS label,
    es.*
  FROM eligible_schools es
  JOIN (
    SELECT MIN(frpm_share) AS min_share
    FROM eligible_schools
    WHERE frpm_share IS NOT NULL
  ) minval ON es.frpm_share = minval.min_share
  -- CDS code from notes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'the CDS code from my notes' AS label,
    es.*
  FROM eligible_schools es
  WHERE es.cds_code = '4615150435602'
)
SELECT
  e.label,
  e.school_name,
  e.county,
  e.city,
  e.mailing_street,
  e.mailing_city,
  e.mailing_state,
  e.mailing_zip,
  e.website,
  e.k12_enrollment,
  e.frpm_eligible,
  e.frpm_share,
  s.avg_sat_total,
  s.pct_1500_plus,
  e.open_date,
  e.status
FROM extremes e
LEFT JOIN sat s ON e.cds_code = s.cds_code
ORDER BY
  CASE e.label
    WHEN 'largest FRPM-eligible count' THEN 1
    WHEN 'smallest FRPM share' THEN 2
    WHEN 'the CDS code from my notes' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END,
  e.school_name;

WITH
-- 1. Identify the set where Abyssal Horror was first printed
abyssal_horror_first_set AS (

  JOIN sets s ON c.set_code = s.code
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
    AND c.mana_cost IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY s.release_date ASC, s.code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 2. Identify the most recent set
most_recent_set AS (
  SELECT
    s.code AS set_code,
    s.name AS set_name,
    s.release_date
  FROM sets s
  WHERE s.release_date = (
    SELECT MAX(release_date) FROM sets
  )
  ORDER BY s.code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 3. Union both target sets
target_sets AS (
  SELECT * FROM abyssal_horror_first_set
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM most_recent_set
),
-- 4. Count total cards with a printed mana cost and those with CMC <= 3 in each set
set_cmc_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ts.set_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.mana_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS total_with_cost,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.mana_cost IS NOT NULL AND c.mana_value <= 3 THEN 1 END) AS with_cmc_le3
  FROM target_sets ts
  JOIN cards c ON c.set_code = ts.set_code
  GROUP BY ts.set_code, ts.set_name
)
SELECT
  set_name,
  ROUND(
    CASE
      WHEN total_with_cost = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE (with_cmc_le3 * 100.0) / total_with_cost
    END
  , 2) AS percent_cmc_le3
FROM set_cmc_stats;

WITH card_colors AS (

    FROM cards c

),
color_format_legality AS (

        r.card_id,
        l.format,
        l.legality
    FROM card_colors r
    JOIN legalities l ON r.card_id = l.card_id
    CROSS JOIN 
        (SELECT value FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(value) as value FROM (
                SELECT substr(colors, instr(colors, '[') + 1, instr(colors, ']') - instr(colors, '[') - 1) as list
                FROM cards
                WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
            ) t, 
            json_each('[' || replace(list, '''', '"') || ']')
        )) cc
    ON cc.value = TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(r.colors,'[',''),']',''),'''',''), ' ', ''))
    WHERE ',' || r.colors || ',' LIKE '%,' || cc.value || ',%'
      AND l.legality = 'Legal'
)

cards_with_guild AS (

foreign_printed_cards AS (

candidate_sets AS (

WITH aven_mindcensor_printings AS (

, newest_frame_info AS (

ruling_counts AS (

),
flavor_printings_per_language AS (

)

WITH commander_sets_2020 AS (
  SELECT

    s.name AS set_name,

    s.set_type = 'commander'
    AND s.released_at >= '2020-01-01'
    AND s.released_at <= '2020-12-31'
),
total_card_counts AS (
  -- We count all cards (including promos and related supplements) for each relevant set,
  -- but excluding those marked as 'alchemy' modifications
  SELECT
    cs.set_id,
    cs.set_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_card_count
  FROM commander_sets_2020 cs
  JOIN cards c ON c.set_id = cs.set_id
  WHERE
    COALESCE(c.layout, '') NOT IN ('alchemy')
  GROUP BY cs.set_id, cs.set_name
),
official_language_counts AS (
  SELECT
    st.set_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count

  GROUP BY st.set_id
),
ranked_sets AS (
  SELECT
    tcc.set_id,
    tcc.set_name,
    tcc.total_card_count,
    COALESCE(olc.language_count, 0) AS language_count
  FROM total_card_counts tcc
  LEFT JOIN official_language_counts olc ON tcc.set_id = olc.set_id
),
max_count AS (

)

WITH germany_users AS (
    SELECT id, reputation
    FROM users
    WHERE LOWER(location) LIKE '%germany%'
),
post_last_editors AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS post_id,
        p.score,
        p.creation_date,
        h.user_id AS last_editor_user_id
    FROM posts p
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            post_id,
            user_id,
            MAX(creation_date) AS max_edit_date
        FROM postHistory

    ON p.id = h1.post_id
    LEFT JOIN postHistory h

        AND h.user_id = h1.user_id

),
posts_2012 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM post_last_editors
    WHERE strftime('%Y', creation_date) = '2012'
),
score_by_last_editor_germany AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL THEN p.score ELSE 0 END) AS score_germany_editor,

    FROM posts_2012 p
    LEFT JOIN germany_users g ON p.last_editor_user_id = g.id
),
germany_editors_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.last_editor_user_id) AS germany_editor_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(g.reputation),0) AS combined_germany_editor_reputation

    INNER JOIN germany_users g ON p.last_editor_user_id = g.id
)

    s.score_germany_editor,
    s.score_non_germany_editor,
    e.germany_editor_count,
    e.combined_germany_editor_reputation
FROM score_by_last_editor_germany s, germany_editors_stats e;

linked_questions AS (

r_tagged_questions AS (

WITH german_users AS (

badge_counts AS (

top_badge_total AS (

second_badge_total AS (

related_counts AS (

WITH active_2012_contributors AS (
    SELECT
        owneruserid AS user_id,
        COUNT(*) AS post_count
    FROM posts
    WHERE
        owneruserid IS NOT NULL
        AND strftime('%Y', creationdate) = '2012'
    GROUP BY owneruserid
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
),
upvotes_cast AS (
    SELECT
        u.id AS user_id,
        COUNT(v.id) AS upvotes_cast
    FROM users u
    LEFT JOIN votes v
        ON u.id = v.userid

user_ages AS (

WITH posts_with_two_or_fewer_answers AS (
  SELECT
    p.id
  FROM
    posts p
    LEFT JOIN posts a ON a.parentId = p.id AND a.postTypeId = 2 -- answers to question
  WHERE
    p.postTypeId = 1 -- question
  GROUP BY
    p.id
  HAVING
    COUNT(a.id) <= 2
),
links_2010 AS (
  SELECT
    pl.relatedPostId AS post_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', pl.creationDate) AS ym
  FROM
    postLinks pl
  WHERE
    pl.creationDate BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
),
counts_by_month AS (
  SELECT
    m.month,
    COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT l.post_id), 0) AS posts_with_link
  FROM
    (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date('2010-01-01', '+' || n || ' months')) AS month
     FROM (
       SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL
       SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL
       SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
     )
    ) m
    LEFT JOIN links_2010 l
      ON l.ym = m.month
      AND l.post_id IN (SELECT id FROM posts_with_two_or_fewer_answers)

)

WITH posts_2010 AS (

high_rep_users AS (

WITH months AS (
  SELECT '2013-01' AS ym UNION ALL SELECT '2013-02' UNION ALL SELECT '2013-03' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2013-04' UNION ALL SELECT '2013-05' UNION ALL SELECT '2013-06' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2013-07' UNION ALL SELECT '2013-08' UNION ALL SELECT '2013-09' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2013-10' UNION ALL SELECT '2013-11'
),
eligible_customers AS (
  SELECT
    t.customer_id,
    t.currency,
    strftime('%Y-%m', t.transaction_date) AS yearmonth
  FROM
    transactions_1k t
  WHERE
    strftime('%Y-%m', t.transaction_date) BETWEEN '2013-01' AND '2013-11'
    AND t.product_category = 'fuel'
)
SELECT
  currency,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS num_customers
FROM (
  SELECT
    ec.customer_id,
    ec.currency
  FROM
    eligible_customers ec
  JOIN months m ON ec.yearmonth = m.ym
  GROUP BY
    ec.customer_id,
    ec.currency
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ec.yearmonth) = 11
)
GROUP BY
  currency
HAVING num_customers = (
  SELECT MAX(cust_count) FROM (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS cust_count
    FROM (
      SELECT
        ec.customer_id
      FROM
        eligible_customers ec
      JOIN months m ON ec.yearmonth = m.ym
      GROUP BY
        ec.customer_id,
        ec.currency
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ec.yearmonth) = 11
    )
    GROUP BY ec.currency
  )
)
;

WITH q2_2013_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        t.customer_id,
        SUM(t.fuel_amount) AS total_fuel
    FROM
        transactions_1k t
    WHERE
        t.tx_date >= '2013-04-01'
        AND t.tx_date < '2013-07-01'
    GROUP BY
        t.customer_id
),
q2_customers AS (
    SELECT
        qt.customer_id,
        qt.total_fuel,
        c.account_currency
    FROM
        q2_2013_transactions qt
        JOIN customers c ON qt.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN account_currency = 'EUR' THEN total_fuel END), 2) AS avg_fuel_eur_customers,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN account_currency = 'CZK' THEN total_fuel END), 2) AS avg_fuel_czk_customers
FROM
    q2_customers
WHERE
    account_currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK');

WITH consumption_2012 AS (
  SELECT
    t.customer_id,
    c.currency,
    STRFTIME('%Y', t.transaction_date) AS year,
    STRFTIME('%m', t.transaction_date) AS month,
    SUM(t.amount) AS monthly_consumption
  FROM
    transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.id
  WHERE
    STRFTIME('%Y', t.transaction_date) = '2012'
  GROUP BY
    t.customer_id, c.currency, year, month
),
avg_consumption_per_customer AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    currency,
    AVG(monthly_consumption) AS avg_monthly_consumption
  FROM
    consumption_2012
  GROUP BY
    customer_id, currency
),
currency_averages AS (
  SELECT
    currency,
    AVG(avg_monthly_consumption) AS avg_customer_consumption
  FROM
    avg_consumption_per_customer
  GROUP BY
    currency
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SELECT avg_customer_consumption FROM currency_averages WHERE currency = 'CZK') -
    (SELECT avg_customer_consumption FROM currency_averages WHERE currency = 'EUR')
  ) AS diff_avg_consumption_czk_minus_eur_2012
;

FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE c.segment = 'KAM'
  AND t.currency = 'CZK'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.transaction_date) = '2013'
  AND t.product_type = 'fuel'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING SUM(t.quantity) > 1000000

FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.product_id

;

FROM Match m
JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_3 = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180

WITH young_players AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM Player
  WHERE birthday >= '1991-01-01'
),
defensive_work_rates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_api_id
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN young_players yp ON pa.player_api_id = yp.player_api_id
  WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
),
high_defensive_work_rates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_api_id
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN young_players yp ON pa.player_api_id = yp.player_api_id
  WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM high_defensive_work_rates) AS REAL) 
    / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defensive_work_rates)) * 100, 2
  ) AS percentage_high_defensive_work_rate

WITH latest_attributes AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_api_id,
    pa.defensive_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id
      ORDER BY pa.date DESC
    ) as rn
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM Player p
JOIN latest_attributes la
  ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
WHERE la.rn = 1
  AND LOWER(la.defensive_work_rate) != 'medium'
  AND la.defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(la.defensive_work_rate) != ''
;

WITH RiskyTeams AS (
  SELECT team_api_id
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
  GROUP BY team_api_id
),
TeamsWithShortNames AS (
  SELECT t.team_api_id, t.team_short_name
  FROM Team t
  JOIN RiskyTeams r ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
  WHERE t.team_short_name IS NOT NULL
),
ShortNameCounts AS (
  SELECT team_short_name, COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) AS club_count
  FROM TeamsWithShortNames
  GROUP BY team_short_name
  HAVING club_count > 1
),
TeamsTarget AS (
  SELECT t.team_api_id, t.team_short_name, ta.chanceCreationPassing
  FROM Team t
  JOIN ShortNameCounts s ON t.team_short_name = s.team_short_name
  LEFT JOIN Team_Attributes ta
    ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
    AND DATE(ta.date) <= '2014-09-19'
  WHERE t.team_short_name IS NOT NULL
),
LatestTeamAttributes AS (
  SELECT team_api_id, team_short_name, chanceCreationPassing,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_api_id ORDER BY DATE(date) DESC) as rn
  FROM Team_Attributes
  JOIN TeamsWithShortNames USING (team_api_id)
  WHERE DATE(date) <= '2014-09-19'
)
SELECT
  s.team_short_name,
  s.club_count,
  ROUND(AVG(l.chanceCreationPassing * 1.0), 1) AS avg_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM ShortNameCounts s
JOIN (
  SELECT team_short_name, team_api_id, chanceCreationPassing
  FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_api_id ORDER BY DATE(date) DESC) as rn
    FROM Team_Attributes
    JOIN TeamsWithShortNames ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = TeamsWithShortNames.team_api_id
    WHERE DATE(date) <= '2014-09-19'
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) l ON s.team_short_name = l.team_short_name
GROUP BY s.team_short_name, s.club_count
ORDER BY avg_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC, s.team_short_name ASC;

FROM Player_Attributes

WITH HomeBigWinMatches AS (
    SELECT
        M.id AS match_id,
        M.season,
        M.stage,
        M.date AS match_date,
        M.home_team_api_id AS team_id,
        M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal AS goal_diff
    FROM Match M
    WHERE (M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal) >= 3
),
LatestFastBuildUp AS (
    SELECT
        ta.team_api_id,
        ta.date AS attrib_date,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
        -- Find the match_id for which this is the latest attributes (on or before match) for each club and match
        hbwm.match_id,
        hbwm.match_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY hbwm.match_id
            ORDER BY ta.date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    JOIN HomeBigWinMatches hbwm
        ON ta.team_api_id = hbwm.team_id
        AND ta.date <= hbwm.match_date
)
SELECT
    t.team_long_name AS club_name,
    t.team_short_name AS club_short_name,
    COUNT(*) AS home_wins_by_3plus_with_fast_buildup
FROM HomeBigWinMatches hbwm
JOIN (
    SELECT
        team_api_id,
        match_id
    FROM LatestFastBuildUp
    WHERE rn = 1 AND buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
) fast_buildup_match
    ON hbwm.match_id = fast_buildup_match.match_id
JOIN Team t
    ON hbwm.team_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
HAVING home_wins_by_3plus_with_fast_buildup = (
    SELECT MAX(wins)
    FROM (
        SELECT
            COUNT(*) AS wins
        FROM HomeBigWinMatches hbwm2
        JOIN (
            SELECT team_api_id, match_id
            FROM LatestFastBuildUp
            WHERE rn = 1 AND buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
        ) fbm2
        ON hbwm2.match_id = fbm2.match_id
        GROUP BY hbwm2.team_id
    )
)
ORDER BY club_name, club_short_name;

WITH italian_league_ids AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM League
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
),
target_seasons AS (
    SELECT '2008/2009' AS season_label, '2008/2009' AS season
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '2015/2016' AS season_label, '2015/2016' AS season
),
players_in_season AS (
    SELECT
        m.season,
        pl.player_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN italian_league_ids ili ON m.league_id = ili.id
    -- select players in home lineup
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 1 as pos UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL 
        SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
    ) AS pos
    LEFT JOIN Player pl ON (
        CASE pos.pos
            WHEN 1 THEN m.home_player_1
            WHEN 2 THEN m.home_player_2
            WHEN 3 THEN m.home_player_3
            WHEN 4 THEN m.home_player_4
            WHEN 5 THEN m.home_player_5
            WHEN 6 THEN m.home_player_6
            WHEN 7 THEN m.home_player_7
            WHEN 8 THEN m.home_player_8
            WHEN 9 THEN m.home_player_9
            WHEN 10 THEN m.home_player_10
            WHEN 11 THEN m.home_player_11
        END
    ) = pl.player_api_id
    UNION
    SELECT
        m.season,
        pl.player_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN italian_league_ids ili ON m.league_id = ili.id
    -- select players in away lineup
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 1 as pos UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL 
        SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
    ) AS pos
    LEFT JOIN Player pl ON (
        CASE pos.pos
            WHEN 1 THEN m.away_player_1
            WHEN 2 THEN m.away_player_2
            WHEN 3 THEN m.away_player_3
            WHEN 4 THEN m.away_player_4
            WHEN 5 THEN m.away_player_5
            WHEN 6 THEN m.away_player_6
            WHEN 7 THEN m.away_player_7
            WHEN 8 THEN m.away_player_8
            WHEN 9 THEN m.away_player_9
            WHEN 10 THEN m.away_player_10
            WHEN 11 THEN m.away_player_11
        END
    ) = pl.player_api_id
),
distinct_players_in_season AS (
    SELECT
        pis.season,
        pis.player_api_id
    FROM players_in_season pis
    WHERE pis.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pis.season, pis.player_api_id
),
player_height AS (
    SELECT
        pa.player_api_id,
        pa.height
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        -- find most recent attribute per player
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) as max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) pamd
    ON pa.player_api_id = pamd.player_api_id AND pa.date = pamd.max_date
)
SELECT
    ts.season_label AS season,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dpi.player_api_id) AS player_count,
    ROUND(AVG(ph.height), 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM target_seasons ts
LEFT JOIN distinct_players_in_season dpi ON dpi.season = ts.season
LEFT JOIN player_height ph ON dpi.player_api_id = ph.player_api_id
GROUP BY ts.season_label
ORDER BY ts.season_label

WITH latest_record AS (
    SELECT
        pa.player_id,
        pa.id,
        pa.date
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            player_id,
            MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_id
    ) latest ON pa.player_id = latest.player_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
),
final_record AS (
    SELECT
        lr.player_id,
        MAX(pa.id) AS record_id
    FROM latest_record lr
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON lr.player_id = pa.player_id AND lr.date = pa.date AND lr.id = pa.id
    GROUP BY lr.player_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM final_record fr
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON fr.record_id = pa.id
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180 AND pa.volley > 70;

WITH ThirdSlotMatches AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS match_id,
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.home_player_3 AS player_id
  FROM
    Match m
  WHERE
    m.home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
),
PlayerHomeGoals AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
  FROM
    ThirdSlotMatches
  GROUP BY
    player_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(total_home_goals), 2) AS avg_total_home_goals_by_player
FROM
  PlayerHomeGoals
WHERE
  player_id IS NOT NULL;

WITH Player_Match_Country AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS match_id,
    l.country_id,
    -- Home players
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    -- Away players
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
),
All_Player_Match_Country AS (
  SELECT match_id, country_id, player_id FROM (
    SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_2 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_3 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_4 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_5 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_6 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_7 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_8 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_9 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_10 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, home_player_11 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_1 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_2 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_3 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_4 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_5 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_6 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_7 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_8 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_9 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_10 FROM Player_Match_Country
    UNION ALL SELECT match_id, country_id, away_player_11 FROM Player_Match_Country
  )
  WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL
),
Player_Weight AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_id,
    pa.weight
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT player_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_id
  ) latest ON pa.player_id = latest.player_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
),
Country_Small_Player_Count AS (
  SELECT
    country_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT apmc.player_id || ':' || apmc.match_id) AS small_player_count
  FROM All_Player_Match_Country apmc
  JOIN Player_Weight pw ON apmc.player_id = pw.player_id
  WHERE pw.weight <= 160
  GROUP BY country_id
),
Min_Count AS (
  SELECT MIN(small_player_count) AS min_count FROM Country_Small_Player_Count
)
SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM Country_Small_Player_Count cspc
JOIN Country c ON cspc.country_id = c.id
JOIN Min_Count mc ON cspc.small_player_count = mc.min_count
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id) AS left_foot_low_or_medium_attack_count
FROM Player_Attributes pa
WHERE pa.date = '2015-01-01'
  AND LOWER(pa.preferred_foot) = 'left'
  AND LOWER(pa.attacking_work_rate) IN ('low', 'medium')

WITH latest_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        pa.player_api_id,
        pa.attacking_work_rate,
        pa.date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.date DESC) as rn
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
),
left_footed_players AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_api_id
    FROM Player p
    WHERE p.preferred_foot = 'left'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 *
        SUM(CASE WHEN la.attacking_work_rate = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
        COUNT(1), 1
    ) AS percentage_left_low_attacking_work_rate
FROM latest_attributes la
JOIN left_footed_players lfp
    ON la.player_api_id = lfp.player_api_id
WHERE la.rn = 1
  AND la.attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE jumping >= 80
  AND date >= '2007-02-22'
  AND date <= '2007-08-30'

WITH team_id_lookup AS (
  SELECT team_api_id
  FROM Team
  WHERE team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
  LIMIT 1
),
last_match AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) AS last_match_date
  FROM Match
  WHERE (home_team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM team_id_lookup)
         OR away_team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM team_id_lookup))
    AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2013'
    AND strftime('%m', date) <= '06'
    AND strftime('%Y', date) || '-' || strftime('%m', date) BETWEEN '2012-07' AND '2013-06'
),
snapshot AS (
  SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM team_id_lookup)
    AND date <= (SELECT last_match_date FROM last_match)
  ORDER BY date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM snapshot;

WITH player_latest_attrs AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_id,
    pa.date,
    pa.overall_rating,
    pa.defensive_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
      PARTITION BY pa.player_id
      ORDER BY pa.date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  WHERE DATE(pa.date) <= '2013-07-12'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 *
    (
      (ld.overall_rating - avg_r.avg_overall_rating)
      / avg_r.avg_overall_rating
    ), 2
  ) AS percentage_higher
FROM (
  SELECT overall_rating
  FROM player_latest_attrs
  WHERE player_id = (
      SELECT player_api_id
      FROM Player
      WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND rn = 1
) ld,
(
  SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating
  FROM player_latest_attrs
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
) avg_r

WITH running_debt_loans AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'D'
),
districts_with_both_years AS (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    JOIN (
        SELECT district_id,
               SUM(CASE WHEN year = 1995 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_1995,
               SUM(CASE WHEN year = 1996 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_1996
        FROM district
        GROUP BY district_id
    ) sub ON d.district_id = sub.district_id
    WHERE sub.has_1995 > 0 AND sub.has_1996 > 0
),
unemployment_rates AS (
    SELECT d.district_id,
           d.A2 AS unemployment_rate,
           d.year
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.year IN (1995, 1996)
)
SELECT 
    u95.district_id,
    u95.unemployment_rate AS unemployment_1995,
    u96.unemployment_rate AS unemployment_1996,
    ROUND(100.0 * (u96.unemployment_rate - u95.unemployment_rate) / u95.unemployment_rate, 2) AS unemployment_rate_pct_change
FROM running_debt_loans rdl
JOIN districts_with_both_years db ON rdl.district_id = db.district_id
JOIN unemployment_rates u95 ON db.district_id = u95.district_id AND u95.year = 1995
JOIN unemployment_rates u96 ON db.district_id = u96.district_id AND u96.year = 1996
ORDER BY unemployment_rate_pct_change DESC

WITH first_account_month AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) AS first_month
  FROM account
),
first_month_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.*, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS population
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.A1
  WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = (SELECT first_month FROM first_account_month)
),
districts_with_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id, district_name, population
  FROM first_month_accounts
),
max_population AS (
  SELECT MAX(population) AS max_pop
  FROM districts_with_accounts
)
SELECT d.district_name, d.population
FROM districts_with_accounts d
JOIN max_population m ON d.population = m.max_pop;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_transactions_without_payment_purpose
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 1, 2) IN ('74', '75', '76')
  AND (t.payment_purpose IS NULL OR TRIM(t.payment_purpose) = '')

WITH repaid_loans AS (
  SELECT 
    loan.loan_id, 
    loan.amount, 
    loan.approved, 
    loan.duration,
    disp.client_id,
    client.district_id
  FROM loan
  JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
  JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
  WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
    AND loan.approved <= DATE('1995-12-31')
    AND DATE('1995-12-31') <= DATE(loan.approved, printf('+%d months', loan.duration))
)
, region_totals AS (
  SELECT
    district.A2 AS region_name,
    SUM(repaid_loans.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM repaid_loans
  JOIN district ON repaid_loans.district_id = district.district_id
  GROUP BY district.A2
)
, max_total AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_amount) AS max_amt FROM region_totals
)
SELECT 
  region_totals.region_name, 
  region_totals.total_amount
FROM region_totals
JOIN max_total ON region_totals.total_amount = max_total.max_amt;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS customer_account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.district_name = 'North Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
      AND t.bank = 'AB'
  );

WITH east_bohemia_districts AS (
    SELECT code, avg_salary
    FROM district
    WHERE region = 'East Bohemia'
),
districts_with_young_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.code, d.avg_salary
    FROM east_bohemia_districts d
    JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.code
    JOIN disp di ON di.account_id = a.account_id AND di.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = di.client_id
    WHERE substr(c.birth_number, 1, 2) BETWEEN '80' AND '89'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_of_avg_salary,
    COUNT(*) AS num_districts
FROM districts_with_young_clients;

WITH central_bohemia_districts AS (
  SELECT district.district_id
  FROM district
  WHERE region = 'central Bohemia'
),
owner_clients AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND c.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM central_bohemia_districts)
),
accounts_without_card AS (
  SELECT oc.client_id, oc.district_id
  FROM owner_clients oc
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM card
  ) ca ON oc.account_id = ca.account_id
  WHERE ca.account_id IS NULL
),
relevant_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id
  FROM accounts_without_card
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.average_salary), 2) AS avg_average_salary
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM relevant_districts);

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS avg_loans_per_account
FROM (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.birth_number < 500101
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
)

WITH male_customers_74_76 AS (
    SELECT c.client_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      AND SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 1, 2) IN ('74', '75', '76')
),
accounts_of_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN male_customers_74_76 mc ON d.client_id = mc.client_id
),
large_payments AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.operation, t.purpose
    FROM trans t
    JOIN accounts_of_cohort a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.amount > 4000
      AND t.operation IS NOT NULL -- exclude standing payment orders (assuming standing orders have NULL in 'operation')
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.purpose = 'SIPO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS household_payments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.purpose IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose != 'SIPO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM large_payments t
WHERE t.purpose IS NOT NULL
   OR t.purpose = 'SIPO'
   OR t.purpose != 'SIPO';

WITH prachatice_branches AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, d.district_name
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.district_name = 'Prachatice'
),
prachatice_accounts_with_loan AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN prachatice_branches pb ON l.account_id = pb.account_id
),
account_owner AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, c.client_id, cl.district_id as owner_district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_open_dates AS (
    SELECT account_id, MIN(date) as opening_date
    FROM order
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_sums AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
counterparties AS (
    -- Counts unique other-bank counterparties per account (based on counter_account, excluding own bank)
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank_account) as num_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.bank_account IS NOT NULL
        AND t.bank_code IS NOT NULL
        -- treat NULL bank_code as our own bank; only count known other-bank transfers
        AND t.bank_code <> ''
        -- only consider actual transfers to/from other banks
        AND (t.type = 'PRIJEM' OR t.type = 'VYDAJ')
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
owner_home_info AS (
    SELECT ao.account_id, ao.client_id, ao.owner_district_id, d.district_name AS owner_district, d.A2 AS owner_population
    FROM account_owner ao
    JOIN district d ON ao.owner_district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT
    pa.account_id AS account_number,
    COALESCE(aod.opening_date, '') AS account_opening_date,
    COALESCE(ls.total_borrowed, 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
    COALESCE(cp.num_counterparties, 0) AS num_outside_bank_counterparties,
    ohi.owner_district,
    ohi.owner_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ohi.owner_population DESC, pa.account_id ASC) AS owner_district_population_rank
FROM
    prachatice_accounts_with_loan pa
LEFT JOIN account_open_dates aod ON pa.account_id = aod.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_sums ls ON pa.account_id = ls.account_id
LEFT JOIN counterparties cp ON pa.account_id = cp.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_owner ao ON pa.account_id = ao.account_id
LEFT JOIN owner_home_info ohi ON pa.account_id = ohi.account_id
ORDER BY owner_district_population_rank, pa.account_id
;

WITH gold_card_holder AS (
  SELECT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id
  FROM card cd
  JOIN disp d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE cd.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_avg_balance AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
filtered_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    g.gender,
    g.account_id,
    g.district_id
  FROM gold_card_holder g
  JOIN account_avg_balance ab ON g.account_id = ab.account_id
  WHERE ab.avg_balance > 1000
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    f.gender,
    d.district_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS inhabitants,
    d.A4 AS avg_salary,
    d.A11 AS urban_ratio
  FROM filtered_accounts f
  JOIN district d ON f.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A3 > 100000
  GROUP BY f.gender, d.district_id
),
agg_stats AS (
  SELECT
    gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) AS num_districts,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio,
    MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants
  FROM district_stats
  GROUP BY gender
),
top_districts AS (
  SELECT
    ds.gender,
    ds.district_id,
    ds.district_name,
    ds.inhabitants
  FROM district_stats ds
  JOIN agg_stats ag ON ds.gender = ag.gender AND ds.inhabitants = ag.max_inhabitants
)
SELECT
  ag.gender,
  ag.num_districts,
  td.district_name AS most_inhabited_district,
  td.inhabitants AS district_inhabitants,
  ag.avg_salary,
  ag.avg_urban_ratio
FROM agg_stats ag
JOIN top_districts td ON ag.gender = td.gender
ORDER BY ag.gender, td.district_name;

WITH large_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 >= 250000
),
owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
gold_card_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
target_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN large_districts ld ON a.district_id = ld.district_id
    WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM owner_accounts)
      AND a.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_card_owners)
),
payments AS (
    SELECT t.bank, t.account AS counter_account, COUNT(*) AS num_payments, SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM target_accounts)
      AND t.date >= '1998-01-01' AND t.date <= '1998-12-31'
      AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_paid DESC) as rnk
    FROM payments
)
SELECT bank AS recipient_bank_code,
       counter_account AS recipient_counter_account_number,
       num_payments AS number_of_outgoing_payments,
       total_paid AS total_amount_paid
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = (SELECT MIN(rnk) FROM ranked)
   OR total_paid = (SELECT MAX(total_paid) FROM payments)
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, recipient_bank_code, recipient_counter_account_number;

WITH pisek_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.district_name = 'Pisek'
),
outgoing_with_purpose AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.k_symbol
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)
      AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
),
sipo_payments AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS sipo_total
    FROM outgoing_with_purpose
    WHERE k_symbol = 'SIPO'
),
all_purposed_payments AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS purposed_total
    FROM outgoing_with_purpose
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * s.sipo_total / NULLIF(a.purposed_total, 0), 2) AS sipo_percentage
FROM sipo_payments s, all_purposed_payments a;

WITH female_owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        d.account_id,
        d.client_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.gender = 'F'
),
accounts_with_card AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM card
),
accounts_with_loan AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM loan
),
target_clients AS (
    SELECT
        foa.client_id,
        foa.account_id
    FROM female_owner_accounts foa
    WHERE foa.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_with_card)
      AND foa.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_with_loan)
),
clients_with_district AS (
    SELECT
        tc.client_id,
        c.district_id
    FROM target_clients tc
    JOIN client c ON tc.client_id = c.client_id
),
districts_for_target AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cwd.district_id
    FROM clients_with_district cwd
),
district_profiles AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS region,
        d.A3 AS district_name,
        d.A11 AS avg_salary,
        d.A17 AS unemp_1996,
        d.A5 AS inhabitants
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM districts_for_target)
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(unemp_1996), 2) AS avg_unemp_1996
    FROM district_profiles
    GROUP BY region
),
most_populous_per_region AS (
    SELECT
        dp.region,
        dp.district_name,
        dp.inhabitants
    FROM district_profiles dp
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            region,
            MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants
        FROM district_profiles
        GROUP BY region
    ) mi ON dp.region = mi.region AND dp.inhabitants = mi.max_inhabitants
),
most_populous_named AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        MIN(district_name) AS most_populous_district
    FROM most_populous_per_region
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    rs.region,
    rs.avg_district_salary,
    rs.avg_unemp_1996,
    mpn.most_populous_district
FROM region_stats rs
JOIN most_populous_named mpn ON rs.region = mpn.region
ORDER BY rs.region;

WITH central_bohemia_districts AS (
  SELECT district_id, name, A2 AS region, inhabitants
  FROM district
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(A2)) IN (
    'central bohemia', 'střední čechy', 'stredni cechy', 'среднечешский край'
  )
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT district_id, name, inhabitants
  FROM central_bohemia_districts
  ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, 
           REPLACE(LOWER(name), 'č', 'c') COLLATE NOCASE ASC
  LIMIT 3
),
crimes_1996_per_district AS (
  SELECT district_id, crime_1996
  FROM district
),
top3_stats AS (
  SELECT
    t3.name,
    t3.inhabitants,
    COALESCE(d.crime_1996,0) AS crime_1996
  FROM top3 t3
  LEFT JOIN crimes_1996_per_district d ON t3.district_id = d.district_id
),
avg_top3 AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(crime_1996 * 1.0), 2) AS avg_crime_top3
  FROM top3_stats
),
avg_all AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(crime_1996,0) * 1.0), 2) AS avg_crime_all
  FROM district
)
SELECT
  t3.name AS district_name,
  t3.inhabitants,
  t3.crime_1996 AS crimes_1996,
  (SELECT avg_crime_top3 FROM avg_top3) AS avg_crimes_top3,
  (SELECT avg_crime_all FROM avg_all) AS avg_crimes_all,
  ROUND((SELECT avg_crime_top3 FROM avg_top3) - (SELECT avg_crime_all FROM avg_all), 2) AS avg_difference
FROM top3_stats t3
ORDER BY t3.inhabitants DESC, REPLACE(LOWER(t3.name), 'č', 'c') COLLATE NOCASE ASC

WITH card_types AS (
  SELECT card.type AS card_type, client.district_id, district.A2 AS district_name, district.A3 AS inhabitants
  FROM card
  JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
  JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
),
min_inhabitants_per_type AS (
  SELECT card_type, MIN(inhabitants) AS min_inhabitants
  FROM card_types
  GROUP BY card_type
)
SELECT
  ct.card_type,
  ct.district_name,
  ct.inhabitants AS inhabitants_in_district
FROM card_types ct
JOIN min_inhabitants_per_type mi
  ON ct.card_type = mi.card_type
  AND ct.inhabitants = mi.min_inhabitants
ORDER BY ct.card_type, ct.district_name

WITH litomerice_region AS (
  SELECT region
  FROM district
  WHERE district_name = 'Litomerice'
),
districts_in_region AS (
  SELECT district_code, district_name
  FROM district
  WHERE region = (SELECT region FROM litomerice_region)
),
accounts_1996 AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_code, a.creation_date
  FROM account a
  JOIN districts_in_region d ON a.district_code = d.district_code
  WHERE a.creation_date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
),
latest_trans_1996 AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN t.date <= '1996-12-31' THEN t.date ELSE NULL END) AS last_date
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_1996)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
final_balance AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN latest_trans_1996 lt
    ON t.account_id = lt.account_id AND t.date = lt.last_date
  WHERE t.trans_id = (
    SELECT MAX(t2.trans_id)
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.account_id = t.account_id AND t2.date = t.date
  )
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    d.district_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS accounts_opened_1996,
    ROUND(AVG(f.balance), 2) AS avg_end_1996_balance
  FROM accounts_1996 a
  JOIN districts_in_region d ON a.district_code = d.district_code
  LEFT JOIN final_balance f ON a.account_id = f.account_id
  GROUP BY d.district_name
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(f.balance), 2) AS region_avg_balance
  FROM accounts_1996 a
  LEFT JOIN final_balance f ON a.account_id = f.account_id
),
max_district AS (
  SELECT district_name, avg_end_1996_balance
  FROM summary
  WHERE avg_end_1996_balance = (SELECT MAX(avg_end_1996_balance) FROM summary)
  ORDER BY district_name
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  s.district_name,
  s.accounts_opened_1996,
  s.avg_end_1996_balance,
  NULL AS region_avg_balance,
  NULL AS district_with_highest_avg_balance
FROM summary s
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  r.region_avg_balance,
  m.district_name
FROM region_stats r, max_district m
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN district_name IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  district_name
;

WITH filtered_loans AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.account_id,
    l.amount,
    a.district_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE l.duration = 24
    AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
ranked_loans AS (
  SELECT
    loan_id,
    account_id,
    amount,
    district_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY amount DESC, loan_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM filtered_loans
),
top10_loans AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM ranked_loans
  WHERE rn <= 10
),
loan_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id
  FROM top10_loans
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.district_id,
    d.A1 AS inhabitants,
    d.A11 AS avg_salary
  FROM district d
  JOIN loan_districts ld ON d.district_id = ld.district_id
),
most_populous_district AS (
  SELECT district_id, inhabitants
  FROM district_stats
  ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
avg_salary_across_districts AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_salary
  FROM district_stats
)
SELECT
  mpd.district_id AS most_populous_district_id,
  mpd.inhabitants,
  avg_salary_across_districts.avg_salary AS average_salary_across_districts
FROM most_populous_district mpd
CROSS JOIN avg_salary_across_districts;

WITH districts_with_population AS (
    SELECT district.district_id, district.name AS district_name, district.region, district.population
    FROM district
    WHERE district.population >= 100000
),
district_accounts AS (
    SELECT disp.district_id, account.account_id
    FROM account
    JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
    GROUP BY disp.district_id, account.account_id
),
district_withdrawals AS (
    SELECT dwp.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM district_accounts dwp
    JOIN trans t ON dwp.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY dwp.district_id
),
district_standing_orders AS (
    SELECT dwp.district_id, o.account_id, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN o.type = 'SIPO' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS standing_order_debit
    FROM district_accounts dwp
    LEFT JOIN "order" o ON dwp.account_id = o.account_id
    GROUP BY dwp.district_id, o.account_id
),
standing_order_burden AS (
    SELECT district_id, 
           ROUND(SUM(standing_order_debit)*1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id), 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM district_standing_orders
    GROUP BY district_id
),
main AS (
    SELECT 
        dwp.district_id,
        d.name AS district_name,
        d.region,
        d.population,
        dw.total_withdrawn,
        ROUND(dw.total_withdrawn * 1.0 / d.population, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        sb.avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM districts_with_population d
    JOIN district_withdrawals dw ON d.district_id = dw.district_id
    LEFT JOIN standing_order_burden sb ON d.district_id = sb.district_id
)
SELECT 
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank,
    avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM main
ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank ASC, district_name

WITH client_home AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id AS home_district_id, d.district_name AS home_district_name, d.region AS home_region
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.client_id = 3541
),
accessible_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date, a.frequency
  FROM disp
  JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE disp.client_id = 3541
),
acc_district AS (
  SELECT a.*, d.district_name, d.region, d.A1 AS avg_salary, d.A2 AS inhabitants
  FROM accessible_accounts a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
district_home_match AS (
  SELECT ad.*, 
    ch.home_district_id,
    ch.home_region,
    CASE WHEN ad.district_id = ch.home_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district
  FROM acc_district ad
  CROSS JOIN client_home ch
),
loan_status AS (
  SELECT l.account_id,
    l.status AS loan_status,
    l.amount AS loan_amount
  FROM loan l
),
acc_loans AS (
  SELECT d.*, 
    COALESCE(ls.loan_status, 'none') AS loan_status,
    COALESCE(ls.loan_amount, 0) AS loan_amount
  FROM district_home_match d
  LEFT JOIN loan_status ls ON d.account_id = ls.account_id
),
trans_agg AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_trans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
with_trans AS (
  SELECT
    al.*,
    COALESCE(ta.num_trans, 0) AS num_trans,
    COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance
  FROM acc_loans al
  LEFT JOIN trans_agg ta ON al.account_id = ta.account_id
),
region_clients AS (
  SELECT d.region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.region
),
region_populous AS (
  SELECT
    d.region,
    d.district_name AS pop_district_name,
    d.A2 AS pop_inhabitants
  FROM district d
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT region, MAX(A2) AS max_inhabitants
    FROM district
    GROUP BY region
  ) dm ON d.region = dm.region AND d.A2 = dm.max_inhabitants
),
district_pop_rank AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    district_id,
    district_name,
    inhabitants,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY inhabitants DESC) AS pop_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT
      d.region,
      d.district_id,
      d.district_name,
      d.A2 AS inhabitants
    FROM district d
  )
)
SELECT
  wt.account_id,
  wt.date AS date_opened,
  wt.frequency,
  wt.district_name,
  wt.region,
  wt.is_home_district,
  wt.avg_salary,
  wt.loan_status,
  wt.loan_amount,
  wt.num_trans,
  wt.total_income,
  wt.total_expense,
  wt.net_balance,
  rc.num_clients AS clients_in_region,
  rp.pop_district_name AS most_populous_district_in_region,
  rp.pop_inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
  dpr.pop_rank AS district_population_rank_in_region
FROM with_trans wt
LEFT JOIN region_clients rc ON wt.region = rc.region
LEFT JOIN region_populous rp ON wt.region = rp.region
LEFT JOIN district_pop_rank dpr ON wt.region = dpr.region AND wt.district_id = dpr.district_id
ORDER BY wt.num_trans DESC, wt.account_id ASC
;

WITH cb_districts AS (

  WHERE region = 'central Bohemia'
),
cb_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, strftime('%Y', a.date) AS year_opened

  WHERE a.date >= '1996-01-01'
),
accounts_with_loan_total AS (
  SELECT ca.account_id, ca.year_opened, ca.district_id, 
         IFNULL(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_lent
  FROM cb_accounts ca
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON ca.account_id = l.account_id
  GROUP BY ca.account_id, ca.year_opened, ca.district_id
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT 
    awlt.year_opened,
    COUNT(awlt.account_id) AS accounts_opened,
    SUM(awlt.total_lent) AS total_amount_lent
  FROM accounts_with_loan_total awlt
  GROUP BY awlt.year_opened
),
district_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    awlt.year_opened,
    awlt.district_id,
    SUM(awlt.total_lent) AS lent_in_district,
    COUNT(awlt.account_id) AS accounts_in_district,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(awlt.account_id) = 0 THEN 0

),
district_yearly_avg AS (

  GROUP BY year_opened
)
SELECT 
  y.year_opened,
  y.accounts_opened,
  y.total_amount_lent,
  dyaa.avg_lent_per_account_across_districts
FROM yearly y
JOIN district_yearly_avg dyaa ON y.year_opened = dyaa.year_opened
ORDER BY y.year_opened;

WITH weekly_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
target_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount AS approved_amount, l.date AS approval_date, l.duration
    FROM loan l
    JOIN weekly_accounts wa ON l.account_id = wa.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
),
loans_with_rank AS (
    SELECT
        tl.loan_id,
        tl.account_id,
        wa.district_id,
        tl.approved_amount,
        tl.approval_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY tl.approved_amount DESC, tl.approval_date ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM target_loans tl
    JOIN weekly_accounts wa ON tl.account_id = wa.account_id
),
loan_balances AS (
    SELECT
        lwr.loan_id,
        lwr.district_id,
        lwr.approved_amount,
        lwr.approval_date,
        t.balance AS balance_on_approval
    FROM loans_with_rank lwr
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = lwr.account_id
        AND t.date = lwr.approval_date
        AND lwr.rn <= 10
    WHERE t.trans_id = (
        SELECT MAX(trans_id)
        FROM trans t2
        WHERE t2.account_id = lwr.account_id
          AND t2.date = lwr.approval_date
    )
)
SELECT
    lb.district_id,
    lb.approved_amount,
    lb.approval_date,
    lb.balance_on_approval
FROM loan_balances lb
JOIN loans_with_rank lwr ON lb.loan_id = lwr.loan_id
WHERE lwr.rn <= 10
ORDER BY lb.approved_amount DESC, lb.approval_date ASC;

applicant_account AS (

outgoing_payments AS (

WITH female_clients AS (
  SELECT client_id, birth_number, district_id
  FROM client
  WHERE gender = 'F'
),
approved_loans AS (
  SELECT loan.*, disp.client_id, account.district_id, account.account_id
  FROM loan
  JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN female_clients ON disp.client_id = female_clients.client_id
  JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
  WHERE loan.status = 'A'
),
top_loans AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM approved_loans
  WHERE amount IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT amount
    FROM approved_loans
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 3
  )
),
branch_districts AS (
  SELECT district_id, district_name, region, avg_salary
  FROM district
),
region_loan_counts AS (
  SELECT d.region, COUNT(*) AS loans_in_region
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.region
),
region_avg_salary AS (
  SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS region_avg_salary
  FROM district
  GROUP BY region
),
account_tx AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
client_age AS (
  SELECT 
    client_id, 
    -- birth_number: YYMMDD#### or YYYYMMDD####
    CASE
      WHEN LENGTH(birth_number) > 6 THEN
        CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year,
        CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS birth_month,
        CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS birth_day
      ELSE
        1900 + CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year,
        CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) AS birth_month,
        CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS birth_day
    END
  FROM client
),
fem_client_ages AS (
  SELECT 
    client_id,
    CASE
      WHEN LENGTH(birth_number) > 6 THEN
        CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE
        1900 + CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
    END AS byear,
    CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, LENGTH(birth_number) - 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS bmonth,
    CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, LENGTH(birth_number) - 3, 2) AS INTEGER) AS bday
  FROM female_clients
),
fem_ages_completed AS (
  SELECT 
    client_id,
    (2026 - byear) - (CASE WHEN bmonth * 100 + bday > 10 * 100 + 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age_on_2026_10_09
  FROM fem_client_ages
)
SELECT
  t.client_id,
  t.loan_id,
  ROUND(t.amount, 2) AS loan_amount,
  t.duration AS duration_months,
  ROUND(t.payments * t.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND(t.payments * t.duration - t.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
  t.status AS loan_status,
  d.district_name,
  d.region,
  tx.trans_count AS account_transaction_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(tx.total_deposits, 0), 2) AS account_total_deposits,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(tx.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * t.amount THEN 'High Income'
    WHEN COALESCE(tx.total_deposits, 0) > t.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
    ELSE 'Low Income'
  END AS income_category,
  rlc.loans_in_region,
  ras.region_avg_salary,
  fa.age_on_2026_10_09
FROM top_loans t
JOIN branch_districts d ON t.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN account_tx tx ON t.account_id = tx.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_loan_counts rlc ON d.region = rlc.region
LEFT JOIN region_avg_salary ras ON d.region = ras.region
LEFT JOIN fem_ages_completed fa ON t.client_id = fa.client_id
ORDER BY t.amount DESC
;

opened_accounts_1997 AS (

SELECT
