WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.name AS district_name, d.region
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND c.issued IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
trans_summaries AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> ''
                THEN t.account2
            WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> ''
                THEN t.account2
            ELSE NULL
        END) AS n_external_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        g.account_id,
        g.district_name,
        g.region,
        COALESCE(ts.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
        COALESCE(ts.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
        COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
        COALESCE(ts.n_external_counterparties, 0) AS n_external_counterparties
    FROM gold_accounts g
    LEFT JOIN trans_summaries ts ON g.account_id = ts.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc ON g.account_id = lc.account_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY n_external_counterparties DESC) AS rank
    FROM summary
)
SELECT
    rank,
    account_id,
    district_name,
    region,
    total_received,
    total_withdrawn,
    loan_count,
    n_external_counterparties
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank, account_id;

WITH tabor_district AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
),
accounts_on_311296 AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date AS open_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN tabor_district td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
),
owner_disp AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, d.client_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
owner_info AS (
    SELECT od.account_id, c.gender, 
           (CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
            (strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5))) AS owner_age_311296
    FROM owner_disp od
    JOIN client c ON od.client_id = c.client_id
),
cards_at_311296 AS (
    SELECT c.account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_cards
    FROM card c
    WHERE c.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.account_id
),
loans_at_311296 AS (
    SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 2
                    WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1
                    WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 0
                    ELSE NULL END) AS max_status_flag
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
loan_standing AS (
    SELECT 
        la.account_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN la.num_loans IS NULL OR la.num_loans = 0 THEN 'no loan'
            WHEN la.max_status_flag = 2 THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN la.max_status_flag = 1 THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_standing_label,
        COALESCE(la.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans
    FROM loans_at_311296 la
),
trans_1997 AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_trans_1997,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in_1997,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'debit' OR t.type = 'withdrawal' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out_1997
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
balances_1997 AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           MAX(balance) AS peak_balance_1997
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
compiled AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        a.open_date,
        oi.gender,
        oi.owner_age_311296,
        COALESCE(ca.num_cards, 0) AS num_cards,
        COALESCE(ls.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
        ls.loan_standing_label,
        COALESCE(tr.num_trans_1997, 0) AS num_trans_1997,
        COALESCE(tr.money_in_1997, 0) AS money_in_1997,
        COALESCE(tr.money_out_1997, 0) AS money_out_1997,
        COALESCE(b.peak_balance_1997, 0) AS peak_balance_1997
    FROM accounts_on_311296 a
    JOIN owner_info oi ON a.account_id = oi.account_id
    LEFT JOIN cards_at_311296 ca ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_standing ls ON a.account_id = ls.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_1997 tr ON a.account_id = tr.account_id
    LEFT JOIN balances_1997 b ON a.account_id = b.account_id
),
ranks AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance_1997 DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
    FROM compiled
)
SELECT 
    c.account_id,
    c.open_date,
    c.gender,
    c.owner_age_311296,
    c.num_cards,
    c.num_loans,
    c.loan_standing_label,
    c.num_trans_1997,
    c.money_in_1997,
    c.money_out_1997,
    c.peak_balance_1997,
    r.peak_balance_rank
FROM compiled c
JOIN ranks r ON c.account_id = r.account_id
ORDER BY r.peak_balance_rank, c.account_id;

WITH owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        d.district_name,
        disp.client_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
classic_card_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        oa.account_id,
        oa.district_id,
        oa.district_name,
        oa.client_id
    FROM owner_accounts oa
    JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = (
        SELECT disp_id FROM disp 
        WHERE account_id = oa.account_id AND client_id = oa.client_id LIMIT 1
    )
    WHERE c.type = 'classic'
),
district_clients AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.district_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cco.client_id) AS num_clients
    FROM district d
    LEFT JOIN classic_card_owners cco ON d.district_id = cco.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.district_name
),
district_payments AS (
    SELECT
        oa.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank || ':' || t.account2) AS num_external_accounts,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) AS total_outgoing
    FROM owner_accounts oa
    JOIN classic_card_owners cco
        ON oa.account_id = cco.account_id AND oa.client_id = cco.client_id
    JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = oa.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(t.bank) != ''
      AND t.bank != 'ZUNO' -- Assuming 'ZUNO' is this bank's code; ignore if not known
    GROUP BY oa.district_id
),
all_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.district_name
    FROM district d
)
SELECT
    ad.district_name,
    COALESCE(dc.num_clients, 0) AS num_classic_card_clients,
    COALESCE(dp.num_external_accounts, 0) AS num_external_accounts_paid,
    COALESCE(dp.total_outgoing, 0) AS total_amount_paid
FROM all_districts ad
LEFT JOIN district_clients dc ON ad.district_id = dc.district_id
LEFT JOIN district_payments dp ON ad.district_id = dp.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, ad.district_name ASC
;

WITH chinese_races_2000s AS (

  FROM races
  JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
  WHERE LOWER(races.name) LIKE '%chinese grand prix%'
    AND races.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
),
with_local_start AS (
  SELECT
    raceId,
    year,
    -- Use the time in HH:MM:SS for comparison; if NULL, use '00:00:00' (treat as missing)
    COALESCE(time, '00:00:00') AS local_start_time
  FROM chinese_races_2000s
),
earliest_race AS (
  SELECT
    raceId,
    year,
    local_start_time
  FROM with_local_start
  WHERE local_start_time = (
    SELECT MAX(local_start_time) FROM (
      SELECT local_start_time
      FROM with_local_start
      WHERE local_start_time = (
        SELECT MIN(local_start_time) FROM with_local_start
      )
    )
  )
),
runner_up AS (
  SELECT
    results.raceId,
    drivers.driverRef,
    results.positionOrder,
    results.time AS runnerup_time,
    results.statusId
  FROM results
  JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
  WHERE results.positionOrder = 2
),
winner AS (
  SELECT
    results.raceId,

  FROM results

)
SELECT
  e.year,
  e.local_start_time,
  ru.driverRef AS runnerup_driver,
  ru.runnerup_time,
  w.winner_time,
  -- Calculate time gap: only if both are in the format '+XX.YYY', otherwise returns NULL
  CASE
    WHEN ru.runnerup_time LIKE '+%' THEN ru.runnerup_time
    WHEN w.winner_time IS NOT NULL AND ru.runnerup_time IS NOT NULL
         AND ru.runnerup_time != ''
         AND w.winner_time != ''
         AND instr(ru.runnerup_time, ':') > 0
         AND instr(w.winner_time, ':') > 0
      THEN
        -- SQLite lacks TIME arithmetic. Return as "See runnerup_time and winner_time columns"
        '[Check runnerup_time and winner_time columns]'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS runnerup_gap_to_winner
FROM earliest_race e
JOIN runner_up ru ON e.raceId = ru.raceId
LEFT JOIN winner w ON e.raceId = w.raceId
LIMIT 1;

WITH local_start_times AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        r.year,
        c.circuitRef,
        TIME(strftime('%s', r.date || ' ' || IFNULL(r.time, '00:00:00')) + (calt.offset * 60), 'unixepoch') AS local_time
    FROM
        races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    LEFT JOIN (
        -- Use circuit.altitude as UTC offset in minutes, as we have no full timezone info; fallback to 0.
        SELECT circuitId, IFNULL(altitude, 0) AS offset FROM circuits
    ) calt ON c.circuitId = calt.circuitId
)
, minmax_times AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(local_time) AS earliest_time,
        MAX(local_time) AS latest_time
    FROM local_start_times
)
, earliest_circuits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
    FROM local_start_times, minmax_times
    WHERE local_time = earliest_time
)
, latest_circuits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
    FROM local_start_times, minmax_times
    WHERE local_time = latest_time
)
SELECT
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef) FROM earliest_circuits) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef) FROM latest_circuits) AS latest_circuit_refs,
    CAST((strftime('%s', (SELECT latest_time FROM minmax_times)) - strftime('%s', (SELECT earliest_time FROM minmax_times))) AS INTEGER) AS time_gap_seconds

WITH over_budget_events AS (

    AND b.semester = (SELECT MAX(semester) FROM budget)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT kind)
FROM (
  SELECT TRIM(item) AS kind
  FROM expense
  WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM over_budget_events)
    AND semester = (SELECT MAX(semester) FROM expense)
    -- Split the description by comma, semicolon, or slash for different kinds
    -- Each item in expense.description is a 'thing' bought, assumed comma separated
    CROSS JOIN
      (
        SELECT value AS item
        FROM (
          SELECT event_id, expense_id, description,
            -- Split by common separators
            TRIM(SUBSTR(description, start + 1, end - start - 1)) AS value
          FROM (
            SELECT
              expense_id, event_id, description,
              ',' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(description, ';', ','), '/', ','), ',', ',') || ',' AS desc_mod,
              instr(',' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(description, ';', ','), '/', ','), ',', ',') || ',', ',', 1) - 1 AS start,
              instr(',' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(description, ';', ','), '/', ','), ',', ',') || ',', ',', 2) - 1 AS end
            FROM expense
            WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM over_budget_events)
              AND semester = (SELECT MAX(semester) FROM expense)
          )
        )
      )
  )
  WHERE kind <> ''
)

hero_superpower_counts AS (

SELECT ROUND(AVG(superpower_count * 1.0), 2) AS avg_superpowers_per_hero

WITH cryokinesis_heroes AS (

),
shared_power_ids AS (

),
relevant_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hero_id
    FROM hero_power
    WHERE power_id IN (SELECT power_id FROM shared_power_ids)
),
hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS num_powers

SELECT ROUND(AVG(num_powers), 1) AS avg_num_powers
FROM hero_power_counts;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.height), 1) AS avg_height_cm
FROM superhero s

WITH races_with_female AS (

),
eligible_heroes AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM superhero
    WHERE (race IS NOT NULL AND race NOT IN (SELECT race FROM races_with_female))

)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM eligible_heroes;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT publisher.id) AS num_publishers
FROM publisher
JOIN superhero ON publisher.id = superhero.publisher_id
WHERE superhero.height_cm > 200

SELECT COUNT(*) AS good_non_dc_heroes
FROM superhero sh
JOIN alignment a ON sh.alignment_id = a.id

WHERE a.name = 'Good' AND p.name <> 'DC Comics';

WITH blackwulf_publisher AS (
    SELECT publisher_id

),
bw_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.eye_colour

),
other_published_eyes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.eye_colour

)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bh.id) AS hero_count
FROM bw_heroes bh
JOIN other_published_eyes oe ON bh.eye_colour = oe.eye_colour;

WITH target_publisher AS (
  SELECT publisher_id
  FROM superhero

),
filtered_heroes AS (
  SELECT race
  FROM superhero
  WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT publisher_id FROM target_publisher)

)
SELECT race, COUNT(*) as race_count
FROM filtered_heroes
GROUP BY race
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
  SELECT MAX(rc) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as rc
    FROM filtered_heroes
    GROUP BY race
  )
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(weight_kg AS FLOAT)), 2) AS avg_female_weight_kg
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE gender.gender = 'Female' AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ha.intelligence), 1) AS avg_intelligence
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE sp.name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')

WITH hero_with_fullname_and_gender AS (
  SELECT
    s.id AS hero_id,
    s.gender_id,
    s.full_name
  FROM superhero s
  WHERE 
    s.full_name IS NOT NULL 
    AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.full_name)) > 0
    AND INSTR(s.full_name, ' ') > 0
    AND s.gender_id IS NOT NULL
),
gender_labels AS (
  SELECT id AS gender_id, gender
  FROM gender
  WHERE gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
),
hero_gender_filtered AS (
  SELECT h.hero_id, g.gender
  FROM hero_with_fullname_and_gender h
  JOIN gender_labels g ON h.gender_id = g.gender_id
),
powers_per_hero AS (
  SELECT h.hero_id, h.gender, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS num_powers
  FROM hero_gender_filtered h
  LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON h.hero_id = hp.hero_id
  GROUP BY h.hero_id, h.gender
)
SELECT
  gender,
  ROUND(AVG(num_powers * 1.0), 2) AS avg_superpowers_per_hero
FROM powers_per_hero
GROUP BY gender;

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 2) AS avg_height_cm,
  ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero
WHERE
  colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment = 'Bad'
  AND height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight)) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment = alignment.id
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour = colour.id
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE alignment.description = 'Bad'
  AND colour.description = 'Green'

  AND weight IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
WHERE p.name = 'George Lucas'
  AND s.weight IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero
WHERE gender = 'Female'
  AND alignment = 'good'
  AND weight IS NOT NULL;

WITH hero_weights AS (
  SELECT id, weight
  FROM superhero
  WHERE weight IS NOT NULL
),
min_weight AS (
  SELECT MIN(weight) AS lightest_weight
  FROM hero_weights
),
lightest_heroes AS (
  SELECT h.id
  FROM hero_weights h
  JOIN min_weight mw
    ON h.weight = mw.lightest_weight
),
powers_per_hero AS (
  SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT superpower_id) AS num_powers
  FROM hero_power
  GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(COALESCE(p.num_powers, 0)), 0) AS max_num_superpowers_among_lightest
FROM lightest_heroes lh
LEFT JOIN powers_per_hero p
  ON lh.id = p.hero_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS neutral_heroes_with_full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.alignment = 'Neutral'
  AND superhero.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(superhero.full_name) != '';

WITH brown_haired_eye_colours AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.color AS eye_color
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN colour h ON s.hair_colour_id = h.id
  JOIN colour e ON s.eye_colour_id = e.id

)
SELECT

FROM superhero s

GROUP BY e.color
ORDER BY non_brown_haired_hero_count DESC, e.color ASC;

SELECT

    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

FROM 
  superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE

  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) != ''
;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.alignment = 'Good' THEN s.id END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 2
  ) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id

SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN eye_colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
   SUM(CASE WHEN eye_colour = 'blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS diff
FROM superhero
WHERE weight IS NULL

WITH patient_sex AS (
    SELECT Patient_ID, Sex
    FROM Patient
),
high_uric_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.Patient_ID, p.Sex
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN patient_sex p ON l.Patient_ID = p.Patient_ID
    WHERE l.Test_Name = 'uric-acid'

        (p.Sex = 'male' AND l.Result > 8.0) OR
        (p.Sex = 'female' AND l.Result > 6.5)

),
sex_counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN Sex = 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Sex = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count
    FROM high_uric_patients
)
SELECT
    male_count,
    female_count,
    CAST(male_count AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(female_count, 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM sex_counts;

WITH AbnormalPTPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.PatientID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.PatientID = l.PatientID
  WHERE DATE('2026-10-09') - DATE(p.BirthDate) > 55 * 365.25
    AND l.TestName = 'PT'
    AND l.ResultValue >= 14
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
  , 2) AS Female_Percentage
FROM Patient p
JOIN AbnormalPTPatients a ON p.PatientID = a.PatientID
;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lab.Patient_ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory lab
LEFT JOIN Patient p ON lab.Patient_ID = p.Patient_ID
WHERE lab.Test_Name = 'CRP'
  AND lab.Result LIKE '%+%'
  AND (p.Description IS NULL OR TRIM(p.Description) = '')

WITH normal_anti_scl70_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.Patient_Id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE (Laboratory.Test_Name = 'anti-Scl-70')
    AND (Laboratory.Result IN ('negative', '0'))
),
female_patients AS (
  SELECT Patient_Id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Gender = 'Female'
),
patients_no_symptom AS (
  SELECT e.Patient_Id
  FROM Examination e
  GROUP BY e.Patient_Id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.Patient_Id) AS cnt
FROM female_patients p
JOIN normal_anti_scl70_patients n ON p.Patient_Id = n.Patient_Id
JOIN patients_no_symptom s ON p.Patient_Id = s.Patient_Id;

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.PatientId, p.Inpatient_Admission
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.PatientId = l.PatientId
    WHERE p.Registry = 'thrombosis'
      AND p.BirthYear BETWEEN 1930 AND 1940
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Inpatient_Admission = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
    , 2) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM eligible_patients;

WITH AntiRNP_Top AS (
    SELECT 
        l1.Laboratory_ID,
        l1.Patient_ID,
        l1.Date,
        l1.Result_Value AS Anti_RNP_Result
    FROM Laboratory l1
    WHERE l1.Test_Name = 'anti-RNP antibody'
    AND l1.Result_Value = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.Result_Value)
        FROM Laboratory l2
        WHERE l2.Test_Name = 'anti-RNP antibody'
    )
),
Bilirubin_In_Top AS (
    SELECT
        a.Laboratory_ID,
        a.Patient_ID,
        a.Date,
        b.Result_Value AS Total_Bilirubin,
        a.Anti_RNP_Result
    FROM AntiRNP_Top a
    JOIN Laboratory b
        ON a.Patient_ID = b.Patient_ID
        AND a.Date = b.Date
        AND b.Test_Name = 'total serum bilirubin'
)
SELECT
    b.Laboratory_ID,
    b.Patient_ID,
    b.Date,
    b.Total_Bilirubin,
    p.Sex,
    p.Birthday
FROM Bilirubin_In_Top b
JOIN Patient p ON b.Patient_ID = p.Patient_ID
WHERE b.Total_Bilirubin = (
    SELECT MAX(Total_Bilirubin) FROM Bilirubin_In_Top
)
ORDER BY b.Laboratory_ID;

WITH eligible_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE DateOfBirth > '1960-01-01' AND ThrombosisCohort = 1
),
raised_rnp_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.PatientID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE
    Laboratory.TestName = 'RNP'
    AND (
      (Laboratory.ResultValue > 10)
      OR (
        Laboratory.ResultValue IS NULL
        AND Laboratory.ResultText NOT NULL
        AND Laboratory.ResultText NOT LIKE '%negative%'
        AND TRY_CAST(Laboratory.ResultText AS REAL) > 10
      )
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM eligible_patients ep
LEFT JOIN raised_rnp_patients rrp ON ep.PatientID = rrp.PatientID
WHERE rrp.PatientID IS NULL

WITH abnormal_ssa_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.Patient_ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.Patient_ID = p.Patient_ID
  WHERE l.Test_Name = 'anti-SSA'
    AND (l.Result NOT IN ('negative', '0') OR l.Result_Value IS NOT NULL AND l.Result_Value != 0)
    AND p.Outpatient_Clinic_Admission_Status = '-'
),
max_rnp_titer AS (
  SELECT l.Patient_ID, l.Result_Value AS anti_rnp_titer
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.Test_Name = 'anti-RNP'
    AND l.Patient_ID IN (SELECT Patient_ID FROM abnormal_ssa_patients)
    AND l.Result_Value IS NOT NULL
),
max_value AS (
  SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_titer) AS highest_titer FROM max_rnp_titer
)
SELECT m.Patient_ID, m.anti_rnp_titer
FROM max_rnp_titer m
JOIN max_value v ON m.anti_rnp_titer = v.highest_titer
ORDER BY m.Patient_ID

WITH mctd_patients_only AS (
  SELECT p.PatientID
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Patient p2
      WHERE p2.PatientID = p.PatientID
        AND p2.Diagnosis != 'MCTD'
    )
),
platelet_normal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.PatientID
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.Exam = 'platelet'
    AND e.ResultValue >= 100
    AND e.ResultValue <= 400
),
anti_rnp_high AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.PatientID
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.Test = 'anti-RNP'
    AND l.Value > 5
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.PatientID) AS patient_count
FROM mctd_patients_only p
JOIN platelet_normal pl ON p.PatientID = pl.PatientID
JOIN anti_rnp_high ar ON p.PatientID = ar.PatientID;

WITH never_examined_patients AS (
  SELECT patient_id, sex
  FROM Patient
  WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM Examination)
),
lab_date_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.sex, 
    l.patient_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.test_date) AS lab_dates_count
  FROM never_examined_patients p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id
  GROUP BY p.sex, l.patient_id
)
SELECT
  sex,
  ROUND(AVG(lab_dates_count), 2) AS avg_lab_dates_per_patient
FROM lab_date_counts
GROUP BY sex

WITH female_inpatients AS (
  SELECT Patient.PatientID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Patient.Gender = 'Female' AND Patient.HospitalizationStatus = 'Inpatient'
),
anti_DNA_max AS (
  SELECT 
    Laboratory.PatientID,
    MAX(Laboratory."anti-DNA antibody level") AS max_anti_DNA_level
  FROM Laboratory
  INNER JOIN female_inpatients ON Laboratory.PatientID = female_inpatients.PatientID
  GROUP BY Laboratory.PatientID
)
SELECT 
  l.PatientID, 
  l.LaboratoryTestDate, 
  l."anti-DNA antibody level"
FROM Laboratory l
INNER JOIN anti_DNA_max m
  ON l.PatientID = m.PatientID
  AND l."anti-DNA antibody level" = m.max_anti_DNA_level
ORDER BY l.PatientID

WITH abnormal_hematocrit AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PatientId
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TestName = 'hematocrit'
      AND (Value <= 29 OR Value >= 52)
),
arnp_positive AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PatientId
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TestName = 'anti-ribonuclear protein'
      AND Value > 16
),
outpatient_registry AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PatientId
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Registry = 'thrombosis'
      AND ClinicType = 'outpatient'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.PatientId) AS patient_count
FROM outpatient_registry p
JOIN abnormal_hematocrit h ON p.PatientId = h.PatientId
JOIN arnp_positive a ON p.PatientId = a.PatientId;

SELECT MAX(anti_ribonuclear_protein) AS highest_anti_rnp
FROM Laboratory
WHERE patient_id IN (
    SELECT id
    FROM Patient
    WHERE clinic = 'Thrombosis Unit Outpatient'
)

WITH overlap_patients AS (
  -- Patients with exactly RA and SJS as definitive diagnoses, no others
  SELECT p.PatientID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN (
    SELECT PatientID,
           GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Suspected=0 THEN DiseaseCode END, ',') AS dx_codes,
           SUM(CASE WHEN Suspected=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dx_count
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY PatientID
  ) e ON p.PatientID = e.PatientID
  WHERE 
    ((INSTR(',' || e.dx_codes || ',', ',RA,') > 0) AND (INSTR(',' || e.dx_codes || ',', ',SJS,') > 0))
    AND (e.dx_count = 2)
)
, lab_status AS (
  -- For each overlap patient, does any platelet result fall in the normal range?
  SELECT o.PatientID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN l.TestName='platelet' AND l.ResultValue > 100 AND l.ResultValue < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal_platelet
  FROM overlap_patients o
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.PatientID = o.PatientID
  GROUP BY o.PatientID
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_normal_platelet_result,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_never_with_normal_platelet_result
FROM lab_status;

WITH sle_examinations AS (
  SELECT e.ExaminationID
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE ',' || LOWER(e.Diagnosis) || ',' LIKE '%,systemic lupus erythematosus,%'
     OR ',' || LOWER(e.Diagnosis) || ',' LIKE '%,systemic lupus erythematosus,%'
     OR LOWER(e.Diagnosis) = 'systemic lupus erythematosus'
     OR LOWER(e.Diagnosis) LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%'
),
female_patients AS (
  SELECT p.PatientID
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE LOWER(p.Sex) = 'female'
),
qualified_lab_records AS (
  SELECT l.TotalProtein - 8.5 AS deviation
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN sle_examinations sle ON l.ExaminationID = sle.ExaminationID
  INNER JOIN Examination e ON l.ExaminationID = e.ExaminationID
  INNER JOIN female_patients fp ON e.PatientID = fp.PatientID
  WHERE l.TotalProtein > 8.5
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(deviation), 3) AS avg_total_protein_deviation_above_upper_bound
FROM qualified_lab_records;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN diagnosis = 'psoriatic arthritis' AND birth_year >= 1960 THEN 1 END) 
    / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN diagnosis = 'psoriatic arthritis' THEN 1 END), 0)
    , 1
  ) AS percent_born_1960_or_later
FROM Patient

SELECT
  p.sex AS sex,

  Laboratory l

WHERE
  l.test_name = 'albumin'

GROUP BY

WITH female_thrombosis_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.gender = 'F'
      AND p.cohort = 'thrombosis'
),
available_arnp_results AS (
    SELECT l.patient_id, l.result_titer
    FROM Laboratory l
    INNER JOIN female_thrombosis_patients f
        ON l.patient_id = f.patient_id
    WHERE l.test_name = 'anti-ribonuclear protein'
),
results_with_numeric_titer AS (
    SELECT 
        patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(result_titer) = 'negative' THEN 0
            WHEN result_titer LIKE '1:%' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(result_titer, 3) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS titer_value
    FROM available_arnp_results
    WHERE result_titer IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN titer_value > 64 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        / COUNT(*)
    , 2) AS percentage_elevated
FROM results_with_numeric_titer
WHERE titer_value IS NOT NULL;

WITH qualifying_lab AS (
  SELECT
    Laboratory.Patient_ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE 
    -- Original scale: grades 3 or 4 (assume stored as integers 3,4 in a column called 'U_PRO_OLD' or similarly; else use numeric/dictionary result)
    (U_PRO = '3' OR U_PRO = '4')
    OR
    -- Scale used since 1987: values 300, 1000, or higher (assume numeric column)
    (CAST(U_PRO AS INTEGER) >= 300)
),
qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient_ID
  FROM qualifying_lab
),
birthyears AS (
  SELECT
    p.Patient_ID,
    p.BirthYear -- assume 'BirthYear' column holds 4-digit year of birth
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN qualifying_patients q
    ON p.Patient_ID = q.Patient_ID
  WHERE p.BirthYear IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(1999 - birthyears.BirthYear) AS avg_age_in_1999
FROM birthyears;

SELECT 
    p.sex AS gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count
FROM

JOIN 
    Laboratory l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id
WHERE 
    l.lab_test_name = 'anti-ribonuclear protein antibody'

    AND p.sex IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY 
    p.sex

WITH thrombosis_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE cohort = 'thrombosis'
),
anti_rnp_tests AS (
  SELECT 
    l.PatientID, 
    l.CollectionDate,
    l.Result,
    p.BirthDate
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN thrombosis_patients tp ON l.PatientID = tp.PatientID
  JOIN Patient p ON l.PatientID = p.PatientID

    AND l.Result GLOB '[0-9]*'
    AND l.CollectionDate IS NOT NULL
    AND p.BirthDate IS NOT NULL
),
ages AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CollectionDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', BirthDate) AS INTEGER) AS whole_years
  FROM anti_rnp_tests
)
SELECT MIN(whole_years) AS youngest_age_with_high_rnp

WITH psoriatic_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE diagnosis = 'psoriatic arthritis'
),
lab_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.patient_id,
    COUNT(Laboratory.id) AS lab_test_count

)
SELECT

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_counts WHERE lab_test_count = 0) AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests
;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.PatientID) AS thrombosis_patient_count

WHERE e.ExamDate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

  AND e.ThrombosisFinding > 0
;

WITH sle_patients AS (

  FROM Patient
  WHERE diseases LIKE '%SLE%' OR diseases LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%'
),
thrombotic_episodes AS (
  SELECT e.patient_id, e.symptom

  WHERE e.event_type = 'thrombotic episode'
)
SELECT symptom

ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, symptom ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH thrombosis_exams AS (
    SELECT Examination.*
    FROM Examination
    WHERE diagnosis = 'thrombosis'
),
thrombosis_with_sle AS (
    SELECT te.id
    FROM thrombosis_exams te
    WHERE te.diagnosis = 'thrombosis'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Examination e2

WITH
-- Find lab visits with LDH strictly between 600 and 800
ldh_lab_visits AS (
  SELECT
    Laboratory.Patient_ID,
    Laboratory.Visit_ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Laboratory.Test_Name = 'LDH'
    AND (
      CAST(Laboratory.Result AS FLOAT) > 600 AND CAST(Laboratory.Result AS FLOAT) < 800
    )
),
-- Find lab visits with proteinuria >= 300 mg/dL, including "at least 300"
proteinuria_lab_visits AS (
  SELECT
    Laboratory.Patient_ID,
    Laboratory.Visit_ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Laboratory.Test_Name = 'Urine Protein'
    AND (
      -- Accept plain numeric >= 300
      (CASE
         WHEN Laboratory.Result GLOB '[0-9]*'
           THEN CAST(Laboratory.Result AS FLOAT)
         ELSE NULL
       END) >= 300
      OR
      -- Accept 'at least XXX' that is >= 300, e.g. "at least 300"
      (LOWER(Laboratory.Result) LIKE 'at least %'
         AND
         CAST(substr(Laboratory.Result, 10) AS FLOAT) >= 300
      )
    )
),
-- Take visits where BOTH findings coexist
qualifying_visits AS (
  SELECT
    ldh_lab_visits.Patient_ID,
    ldh_lab_visits.Visit_ID
  FROM ldh_lab_visits
  INNER JOIN proteinuria_lab_visits
    ON ldh_lab_visits.Patient_ID = proteinuria_lab_visits.Patient_ID
    AND ldh_lab_visits.Visit_ID = proteinuria_lab_visits.Visit_ID
),
-- Select patients where at least one qualifying visit exists
qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient_ID
  FROM qualifying_visits
)
-- Output patient ID and completed age in years as of 2026-10-09
SELECT
  Patient.Patient_ID,
  CAST(
    (strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Date_of_Birth)) -
    (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', Patient.Date_of_Birth))

FROM Patient
INNER JOIN qualifying_patients

      ELSE NULL 
    END AS care_setting,
    COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS num_patients
  FROM Patient
  WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM confirmed_sle_patients)
    AND admission_type IN ('inpatient', 'outpatient')
  GROUP BY care_setting
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT num_patients FROM admission_type_counts WHERE care_setting = 'inpatient') AS inpatients,
    (SELECT num_patients FROM admission_type_counts WHERE care_setting = 'outpatient') AS outpatients
)
SELECT
  inpatients,
  outpatients,
  ROUND(CAST(inpatients AS REAL) * 100.0 / (inpatients + outpatients), 2) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM summary;

WITH ldh_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE
    test_name = 'LDH'
    AND (
      -- Numeric value 500 or higher (may include equality)
      (CAST(result AS FLOAT) >= 500)
      OR
      -- Result string >=500 (cover cases like '>=500')
      (result LIKE '>=%' AND CAST(SUBSTR(result, 3) AS FLOAT) >= 500)
      OR
      -- Explicitly mention 500 (rare string forms)
      (result = '500')
    )
),
protein_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE
    (
      test_name = 'Urinary protein'
      OR test_name = 'Urine protein'
    )
    AND (
      -- Numeric mg/dL value of 100 or higher, direct numeric
      (CAST(result AS FLOAT) >= 100)
      OR
      -- Form: '>=100', '>=300', etc.
      (result LIKE '>=%' AND CAST(SUBSTR(result, 3) AS FLOAT) >= 100)
      OR
      -- Form: '+2(100)', '+3(300)' etc., extract mg/dL in parentheses
      (result GLOB '*(*' AND
        CAST(
          SUBSTR(
            result,
            INSTR(result, '(') + 1,
            INSTR(result, ')') - INSTR(result, '(') - 1
          ) AS FLOAT
        ) >= 100
      )
      OR
      -- Directly '100' (text)
      (result = '100')
    )
)

eligible_patients AS (

patient_care_setting AS (

no_thrombosis_patients AS (

cpk_results AS (

never_above_normal AS (

sex_counts AS (

WITH molecule_bond_info AS (

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (

molecule_elements AS (

unique_elements AS (

carcinogenic_unique_molecules AS (

molecules_with_nitrogen_dbl_trp AS (

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (

  WHERE b.type = 'triple'
), counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,

SELECT

WITH all_element_counts AS (
  SELECT
    element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS mol_count
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY element
),
rare_elements AS (
  SELECT element
  FROM all_element_counts
  WHERE mol_count = 1
),
carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE carcinogenic = '+'
),
qualified_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.element
  FROM atom a
  JOIN rare_elements r ON a.element = r.element
  JOIN carcinogenic_molecules m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
),
bonds_with_rare_atoms AS (
  SELECT
    q.molecule_id,
    b.bond_id
  FROM qualified_molecules q
  JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = q.molecule_id AND a.element = q.element
  JOIN bond b
    ON (b.atom1_id = a.atom_id OR b.atom2_id = a.atom_id)
    AND b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) as rare_atom_bond_count
  FROM bonds_with_rare_atoms
  GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT
  molecule_id,
  rare_atom_bond_count
FROM bond_counts
ORDER BY molecule_id;

WITH
carbon_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'C'
),
chlorine_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'Cl'
),
carbon_touching_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.atom1_id = a1.atom_id
  WHERE a1.element = 'C'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.atom2_id = a2.atom_id
  WHERE a2.element = 'C'
),
multiple_bonds AS (
  SELECT bond_id, molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
),
molecule_atom_counts AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_carbon_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_chlorine_atoms
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
molecule_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_multiple_bonds
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
final_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.carcinogenicity_label,
    ac.num_atoms,
    bc.num_bonds,
    ac.num_carbon_atoms,
    ac.num_chlorine_atoms,
    COALESCE(ctbc.num_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
    bc.num_multiple_bonds
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN molecule_atom_counts ac ON m.molecule_id = ac.molecule_id
  JOIN molecule_bond_counts bc ON m.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds
    FROM carbon_touching_bonds
    GROUP BY molecule_id
  ) ctbc ON m.molecule_id = ctbc.molecule_id
  WHERE ac.num_carbon_atoms >= 1
)
SELECT
  RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY num_carbon_touching_bonds DESC, num_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank,
  molecule_id,
  carcinogenicity_label,
  num_atoms,
  num_bonds,
  num_carbon_atoms,
  num_chlorine_atoms,
  num_carbon_touching_bonds,
  num_multiple_bonds
FROM final_counts
ORDER BY rank
;

SELECT

WITH filtered_bonds AS (
  SELECT 
    b.kind,
    b.element1,
    b.element2
  FROM bond b
  JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule = m.id
  WHERE m.id = 'TR377' AND b.kind IN ('-', '=')
),
bond_kind_counts AS (
  SELECT
    kind,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
      CASE 
        WHEN element1 < element2 THEN element1 || '-' || element2 
        ELSE element2 || '-' || element1 
      END
    ) AS element_pair_count
  FROM filtered_bonds
  GROUP BY kind
),
label_info AS (
  SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE id = 'TR377'
)
SELECT
  bkc.kind AS bond_kind_symbol,
  bkc.bond_count,
  bkc.element_pair_count,
  li.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_kind_counts bkc
CROSS JOIN label_info li
ORDER BY bkc.bond_count DESC, bkc.kind ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND LOWER(a.element) IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  AND b.type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH atom_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    a.id AS atom_id,
    a.element_symbol,
    COUNT(b.id) AS total_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM atom a
  JOIN bond b ON a.id = b.atom1_id OR a.id = b.atom2_id
  GROUP BY a.id, a.element_symbol
)
SELECT
  element_symbol,
  COUNT(*) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM atom_bond_counts
WHERE total_bonds = single_bonds -- only single bonds
  AND multiple_bonds = 0         -- never part of any multiple bond
  AND total_bonds > 0            -- must have at least one bond
GROUP BY element_symbol
ORDER BY element_symbol;

WITH triple_bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.molecule_id, a.element
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
),
element_molecule_counts AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM triple_bond_atoms
  GROUP BY element
)
SELECT element, molecule_count
FROM element_molecule_counts
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element ASC;

SELECT
  a.element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS atoms_in_bond
FROM
  atom a
JOIN
  molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.id
JOIN
  bond b ON (b.atom1 = a.id OR b.atom2 = a.id)
WHERE
  m.name = 'TR397'
GROUP BY
  a.element
ORDER BY
  a.element ASC
